example: She was deserted by her husband.
definition_zh: 让某人失去帮助或支持。
example_zh: 她被丈夫抛弃了。

definition: to do something or show qualities that mean a particular reaction, reward or punishment is appropriate
example: deserve something, You deserve a rest after all that hard work.
definition_zh: 做某事或表现出某种品质，从而导致某种反应、奖励或惩罚是合适的
example_zh: 值得拥有点什么，你值得休息，毕竟你辛苦了。

definition: a strong wish to have or do something
example: He now had enough money to satisfy all his desires.
definition_zh: 强烈想要拥有或去做某件事
example_zh: 他现在有足够的钱满足所有欲望。

definition: to want something; to wish for something
example: desire something, We all desire health and happiness.
definition_zh: 想要某样东西;去许愿
example_zh: 渴望某样东西，我们都渴望健康和幸福。

definition: feeling or showing that you have little hope and are ready to do anything without worrying about danger to yourself or others
example: The prisoners grew increasingly desperate.
definition_zh: 感到或表现出自己几乎没有希望，并且愿意做任何事而不担心对自己或他人的危险
example_zh: 囚犯们的绝望愈发迫切。

definition: in a way that shows you have little hope and are ready to do anything without worrying about danger to yourself or others
example: She looked desperately around for a weapon.
definition_zh: 以一种表明你几乎没有希望、愿意做任何事而不用担心自己或他人危险的方式
example_zh: 她拼命地四处张望，寻找武器。

definition: the act of destroying something; the process of being destroyed
example: the destruction of the rainforests
definition_zh: 摧毁某物的行为;被毁灭的过程
example_zh: 雨林的毁灭

definition: to give a list of facts or all the available information about something
example: The brochure details all the hotels in the area and their facilities.
definition_zh: 给出一份事实列表或关于某事的所有可用信息
example_zh: 宣传册详细介绍了该地区所有酒店及其设施。

definition: giving many details and a lot of information; paying great attention to details
example: a detailed description of the events
definition_zh: 提供大量细节和信息;对细节极为关注
example_zh: 对事件的详细描述

definition: to discover or notice something, especially something that is not easy to see, hear, etc.
example: The tests are designed to detect the disease early.
definition_zh: 发现或注意到某样东西，尤其是那些不容易看见、听到的东西。
example_zh: 这些检测旨在及早发现疾病。

definition: the quality that makes you continue trying to do something even when this is difficult
example: fierce/grim/dogged determination
definition_zh: 这种品质让你即使困难，也坚持尝试做某件事
example_zh: 坚定/坚韧/坚韧的决心

definition: to give your time or effort to a particular activity or purpose
example: She devotes much of her time to helping others.
definition_zh: 将你的时间或精力投入到某项特定活动或目的上
example_zh: 她将大量时间投入到帮助他人上。

definition: to be different from somebody/something
example: They hold differing views.
definition_zh: 与某人/某物不同
example_zh: 他们持有不同的观点。

definition: to make a hole in the ground or to move soil from one place to another using your hands, a tool or a machine
example: I think I'll do some digging in the garden.
definition_zh: 用手、工具或机器在地上挖个洞，或将土壤从一个地方移到另一个地方
example_zh: 我想我会去花园里挖挖。

definition: a physical or mental condition that makes it difficult for somebody to do some things that most other people can do
example: a physical/developmental/intellectual disability
definition_zh: 一种身体或心理状况，使某人难以完成大多数人能完成的某些事情
example_zh: 身体/发育/智力障碍

definition: having a condition that makes it difficult for you to do some things that most other people can do
example: physically/developmentally/intellectually disabled
definition_zh: 有一种状况让你难以完成大多数人能做的事情
example_zh: 身体/发育/智力障碍

definition: a situation where people have different opinions about something and often argue
example: disagreement (about/on/over/as to something), Disagreement arose about exactly how to plan the show.
definition_zh: 一种人们对某件事有不同看法、经常争吵的情况
example_zh: 分歧（关于/关于某件事），产生了关于如何具体策划这部剧的分歧。

definition: to make somebody feel sad because something that they hope for or expect to happen does not happen or is not as good as they hoped
example: disappoint (somebody), Her decision to cancel the concert is bound to disappoint her fans.
definition_zh: 让某人因为他们所期望或期待的事情没有发生，或者没有达到预期而感到难过
example_zh: 令人失望（某人），她取消演唱会的决定注定会让粉丝失望。

definition: the feeling of being sad because something has not happened or been as good, successful, etc. as you expected or hoped
example: Book early for the show to avoid disappointment.
definition_zh: 那种因为事情没有发生、没有达到你预期或期望的那样好、成功等而感到难过的感觉
example_zh: 尽早预订演出以避免失望。

definition: a thin flat round object
example: He wears an identity disc around his neck.
definition_zh: 一个薄而扁平的圆形物体
example_zh: 他脖子上挂着一张身份识别盘。

definition: the practice of training people to obey rules and orders and punishing them if they do not; the controlled behaviour or situation that is the result of this training
example: The school has a reputation for high standards of discipline.
definition_zh: 训练人们服从规则和命令，若不遵守则予以惩罚;这种训练所导致的受控行为或情境
example_zh: 学校以严格的纪律标准著称。

definition: to take an amount of money off the usual cost of something; to sell something at a discount
example: be discounted by something, Most of our stock has been discounted by up to 40 per cent.
definition_zh: 从某物的通常成本中扣除一定金额;以折扣价出售某物
example_zh: 被折价了，我们的大部分库存已经折价了多达40%。

definition: to try to prevent something or to prevent somebody from doing something, especially by making it difficult to do or by showing that you do not approve of it
example: discourage (doing) something, a campaign to discourage smoking among teenagers
definition_zh: 试图阻止某事或阻止某人做某事，尤其是通过让事情变得困难或表现出你不赞成
example_zh: 劝阻（做某事）活动，旨在劝阻青少年吸烟

definition: not honest; intending to trick people
example: Beware of dishonest traders in the tourist areas.
definition_zh: 不诚实;打算欺骗别人
example_zh: 在旅游区要当心不诚实的商贩。

definition: a thin flat round object
example: Red blood cells are roughly the shape of a disk.
definition_zh: 一个薄而扁平的圆形物体
example_zh: 红细胞大致呈盘状。

definition: to decide that somebody/something is not important and not worth thinking or talking about
example: dismiss somebody/something, to dismiss a suggestion/a claim/an idea
definition_zh: 决定某人/某事不重要，不值得思考或讨论
example_zh: 否定某人/某物，以否定一个建议/一个主张/一个想法

definition: a condition or illness that causes problems with the way part of the body or brain works
example: a blood/bowel disorder
definition_zh: 一种导致身体或大脑部分功能出现问题的状况或疾病
example_zh: 一种血液/肠道疾病

definition: an arrangement of things in a public place to inform or entertain people or advertise something for sale
example: a beautiful floral display
definition_zh: 在公共场所摆放物品，用来告知或娱乐人们，或宣传出售商品
example_zh: 美丽的花艺展示

definition: to put something in a place where people can see it easily; to show something to people
example: display something, The exhibition gives local artists an opportunity to display their work.
definition_zh: 把东西放在人们容易看到的地方;向人们展示某样东西
example_zh: 展示一些东西，展览为本地艺术家提供了展示作品的机会。

definition: far away in space or time
example: the distant sound of music
definition_zh: 遥远的空间或时间
example_zh: 远处传来的音乐声

definition: easily or clearly heard, seen, felt, etc.
example: There was a distinct smell of gas.
definition_zh: 容易或清晰地听到、看见、感受到等。
example_zh: 空气中弥漫着明显的煤气味。

definition: to recognize the difference between two people or things
example: distinguish between A and B, At what age are children able to distinguish between right and wrong?
definition_zh: 识别两个人或两个事物之间的区别
example_zh: 区分A和B，孩子什么年龄能分辨对与错？

definition: to take somebody’s attention away from what they are trying to do
example: You're distracting me from my work.
definition_zh: 把别人的注意力从他们正在做的事情上转移开
example_zh: 你在分散我对工作的注意力。

definition: to give things to a large number of people; to share something between a number of people
example: distribute something, The leaflets have been widely distributed.
definition_zh: 把东西送给大量人;在多人之间分享某样东西
example_zh: 分发点东西，传单已经广泛散发。

definition: the way that something is spread or exists over a particular area or among a particular group of people
example: distribution of something, They studied the geographical distribution of the disease.
definition_zh: 某样东西在特定区域或特定群体中传播或存在的方式
example_zh: 某种分布，他们研究了疾病的地理分布。

definition: an area of a country or town, especially one that has particular features
example: the City of London’s financial district
definition_zh: 一个国家或城镇的区域，尤其是具有特殊特征的区域
example_zh: 伦敦金融城金融区

definition: to interrupt somebody when they are trying to work, sleep, etc.
example: I'm sorry to disturb you, but can I talk to you for a moment?
definition_zh: 在别人试图工作、睡觉等时打断他们。
example_zh: 抱歉打扰你，我能和你谈一会儿吗？

definition: a jump into deep water with your head first and your arms in front of you
example: a spectacular high dive (= from high above the water)
definition_zh: 头朝前、双臂前方跳入深水
example_zh: 壮观的高空跳水（= 从水面高处跳水）

definition: to jump into water with your head and arms going in first
example: dive (from/off something) (into something), We dived into the river to cool off.
definition_zh: 跳进水里时，头和手臂先下水
example_zh: 跳进（从某物/从某物上）（进入某物），我们跳进河里降温。

definition: very different from each other and of various kinds
example: People from diverse cultures were invited to the event.
definition_zh: 彼此之间差异很大，种类各异
example_zh: 来自不同文化背景的人们都受邀参加了此次活动。

definition: a range of many people or things that are very different from each other
example: the biological diversity of the rainforests
definition_zh: 由许多彼此截然不同的人或事物组成的范围
example_zh: 雨林的生物多样性

definition: a difference between two groups of people or two things that separates them from each other
example: He offered advice on bridging cultural divides.
definition_zh: 两群人之间的差异，或者将他们区分开来的两件事
example_zh: 他提出了弥合文化鸿沟的建议。

definition: the process or result of dividing into separate parts; the process or result of dividing something or sharing it out
example: The organism begins as a single cell and grows by cell division.
definition_zh: 分割成不同部分的过程或结果;分割或分享某物的过程或结果
example_zh: 该生物最初是一个单细胞，通过细胞分裂而生长。

definition: the legal ending of a marriage
example: The marriage ended in divorce in 1996.
definition_zh: 婚姻的法律终结
example_zh: 这段婚姻于1996年以离婚告终。

definition: to end your marriage to somebody legally
example: They're getting divorced.
definition_zh: 以法律方式结束你与某人的婚姻
example_zh: 他们要离婚了。

definition: to record something in the form of a written document, photograph, film, etc.
example: Urban life in the nineteenth century is well documented.
definition_zh: 以书面文件、照片、胶片等形式记录某物。
example_zh: 十九世纪的城市生活有详尽的记录。

definition: of or inside a particular country; not foreign or international
example: domestic affairs/politics
definition_zh: 来自特定国家或在特定国家境内;非外国或国际
example_zh: 国内事务/政治

definition: more important, powerful or easy to notice than other things
example: The firm has achieved a dominant position in the world market.
definition_zh: 比其他事物更重要、更有力量或更容易被注意到
example_zh: 该公司已在全球市场取得了主导地位。

definition: to control or have a lot of influence over somebody/something, especially in an unpleasant way
example: She always says a lot in meetings, but she doesn't dominate.
definition_zh: 控制或对某人/某物产生巨大影响，尤其是以一种令人不快的方式
example_zh: 她在会议上总是说很多话，但她并不主导一切。

definition: something that is given to a person or an organization such as a charity, in order to help them; the act of giving something in this way
example: a generous/large/small donation
definition_zh: 为帮助某人或慈善机构而给予某项物品;以这种方式给予某物的行为
example_zh: 慷慨/大额/小额捐赠

definition: a small round mark, especially one that is printed
example: There are dots above the letters i and j.
definition_zh: 一个小圆的标记，尤其是印刷好的那种
example_zh: 字母 i 和 j 上方有点。

definition: in, towards or typical of the centre of a city, especially its main business area
example: a downtown store
definition_zh: 位于城市中心、朝向或典型的市中心，尤其是其主要商业区
example_zh: 市中心商店

definition: in or towards the centre of a city, especially its main business area
example: to go/work downtown
definition_zh: 位于城市中心或其主要商业区附近
example_zh: 去市中心工作/上班

definition: the centre of a city, especially its main business area
example: a hotel in the heart of downtown
definition_zh: 城市中心，尤其是其主要商业区
example_zh: 市中心的一家酒店

definition: towards the ground; towards a lower place or position
example: She was lying face downwards on the grass.
definition_zh: 朝向地面;朝向较低的位置或位置
example_zh: 她脸朝下躺在草地上。

definition: a group of twelve of the same thing
example: Give me a dozen, please.
definition_zh: 一群十二个同类生物
example_zh: 给我一打，拜托。

definition: a group of twelve of the same thing
example: Give me a dozen, please.
definition_zh: 一群十二个同类生物
example_zh: 给我一打，拜托。

definition: a rough written version of something that is not yet in its final form
example: This is only the first draft of my speech.
definition_zh: 一个尚未最终成形的粗略写作版本
example_zh: 这只是我演讲稿的第一稿。

definition: to write the first rough version of something such as a letter, speech, book or law
example: I'll draft a letter for you.
definition_zh: 写出一本书的初步版本，比如信件、演讲稿、书籍或法律
example_zh: 我帮你起草一封信。

definition: to pull somebody/something along with effort and difficulty
example: drag somebody/something, The sack is too heavy to lift—you’ll have to drag it.
definition_zh: 用努力和困难拉着某人或某物前进
example_zh: 拖着某个人/什么东西，麻袋太重，搬不动——你得拖着它。

definition: sudden, very great and often surprising
example: a dramatic increase/change/improvement/shift
definition_zh: 突然、非常伟大，而且常常令人惊讶
example_zh: 剧烈的增加/变化/改善/转变

definition: very suddenly and to a very great and often surprising degree
example: Prices have fallen dramatically.
definition_zh: 非常突然，而且以一种极其巨大、常常令人惊讶的程度
example_zh: 价格大幅下跌。

definition: a long period of time when there is little or no rain
example: Farmers are facing ruin after two years of severe drought.
definition_zh: 一段长时间几乎没有降雨的时期
example_zh: 经过两年严重干旱，农民正面临破产。

definition: not interesting or exciting
example: Life in a small town could be deadly dull.
definition_zh: 既不有趣也不令人兴奋
example_zh: 小镇生活有时会无聊得要命。

definition: to get rid of something you do not want, especially in a place that is not suitable
example: Too much toxic waste is being dumped at sea.
definition_zh: 把你不想要的东西扔掉，尤其是在一个不合适的地方
example_zh: 大量有毒废料被倾倒在海上。

definition: the length of time that something lasts or continues
example: The school was used as a hospital for the duration of the war.
definition_zh: 某件事持续或持续的时间长度
example_zh: 这所学校在整个战争期间一直作为医院使用。

definition: having a lot of energy and a strong personality
example: a dynamic leader
definition_zh: 精力充沛，性格坚强
example_zh: 一位充满活力的领导者

definition: the study of how a society organizes its money, trade and industry
example: He studied politics and economics at Yale.
definition_zh: 研究一个社会如何组织其货币、贸易和工业
example_zh: 他在耶鲁大学学习政治和经济学。

definition: a person who studies or writes about economics
example: the World Bank's chief economist
definition_zh: 一个研究或撰写经济学的人
example_zh: 世界银行首席经济学家

definition: to prepare a piece of writing, a book, etc. to be published by correcting the mistakes, making improvements to it, etc.
example: edit (something), This draft text will need to be edited.
definition_zh: 通过纠正错误、改进内容等，准备一篇文章、一本书等以供出版。
example_zh: 编辑（某项），这份草稿文本需要进行编辑。

definition: the form in which a book, newspaper, etc. is published
example: a paperback/hardback edition
definition_zh: 书籍、报纸等以何种形式出版
example_zh: 平装/精装版

definition: connected with the task of preparing something such as a newspaper, a book or a television or radio programme, to be published or broadcast
example: the magazine’s editorial staff
definition_zh: 与准备报纸、书籍或电视或广播节目等内容以出版或播出相关任务相关
example_zh: 杂志编辑团队

definition: doing something in a good, careful and complete way with no waste of time, money or energy
example: a highly efficient worker
definition_zh: 以良好、细致且完整的方式完成某件事，不浪费时间、金钱或精力
example_zh: 一位高效员工

definition: in a good and careful way, with no waste of time, money or energy
example: a very efficiently organized event
definition_zh: 以良好且细致的方式进行，绝不浪费时间、金钱或精力
example_zh: 一次组织极为高效的活动

definition: the joint between the upper and lower parts of the arm where it bends in the middle
example: She jabbed him with her elbow.
definition_zh: 手臂上下部分之间的关节，中部弯曲处
example_zh: 她用胳膊肘戳了他一下。

definition: used as a polite word for ‘old’
example: an elderly man/woman/lady
definition_zh: 作为“老”的委婉称呼
example_zh: 一位年长的男士/女士/女士

definition: to choose somebody to do a particular job by voting for them
example: elect somebody/something, Voters will elect a new president on 30 March next year.
definition_zh: 通过投票选出某人担任某项职务
example_zh: 选出某人，选民将在明年3月30日选出新总统。

definition: the branch of science and technology that studies electric currents in electronic equipment
example: the electronics industry
definition_zh: 研究电子设备电流的科学与技术分支
example_zh: 电子工业

definition: attractive and showing a good sense of style
example: She was tall and elegant.
definition_zh: 有吸引力，且展现出良好的品味
example_zh: 她身材高挑，气质优雅。

definition: in or connected with the first stages of a course of study
example: an elementary English course
definition_zh: 在学习课程的初期阶段中或与之相关的
example_zh: 一门初级英语课程

definition: to remove or get rid of something
example: eliminate something, Credit cards eliminate the need to carry a lot of cash.
definition_zh: 移除或摆脱某些东西
example_zh: 信用卡消除了携带大量现金的需求。

definition: in, at or to another place or other places
example: Dissatisfied customers will look elsewhere.
definition_zh: 在、在或前往其他地方或其他地方
example_zh: 不满意的客户会另觅他处。

definition: to put your arms around somebody as a sign of love or friendship
example: They embraced and promised to keep in touch.
definition_zh: 把手臂环抱某人，作为爱或友谊的象征
example_zh: 他们拥抱并承诺保持联系。

definition: to move out of or away from something and become possible to see
example: The crabs emerge at low tide to look for food.
definition_zh: 让自己离开或远离某样东西，变得可能被看见
example_zh: 退潮时，螃蟹会出水寻找食物。

definition: the production or sending out of light, heat, gas, etc.
example: the emission of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere
definition_zh: 光、热、气体等的产生或释放。
example_zh: 二氧化碳向大气中排放

definition: connected with people’s feelings (= with the emotions)
example: emotional problems/stress
definition_zh: 与人们的感受相连（= 与情绪）
example_zh: 情绪问题/压力

definition: in a way that is connected with people's feelings (= with the emotions)
example: emotionally disturbed children
definition_zh: 以一种与人们的感受相关联的方式（= 与情绪）
example_zh: 情绪障碍儿童

definition: special importance that is given to something
example: emphasis on/upon something, Since the elections there has been a greater emphasis on education.
definition_zh: 赋予某物特殊意义
example_zh: 强调某件事，自选举以来，教育的重视有所增加。

definition: to give special importance to something
example: emphasize something, His speech emphasized the importance of attracting industry to the town.
definition_zh: 赋予某件事特殊意义
example_zh: 强调点什么，他的演讲强调了吸引工业到镇上的重要性。

definition: a group of countries or states that are controlled by one leader or government
example: These invasions almost led to the collapse of the Roman Empire.
definition_zh: 一组由一位领导人或政府控制的国家或国家
example_zh: 这些入侵几乎导致了罗马帝国的崩溃。

definition: to make it possible for somebody/something to do something
example: This new programme will enable older people to study at college.
definition_zh: 为了让某人/某物能够做某件事
example_zh: 这一新项目将使年长者能够进入大学学习。

definition: a meeting, especially one that is sudden, unexpected or violent
example: a chance encounter
definition_zh: 一次会面，尤其是突然、出乎意料或暴力的会面
example_zh: 一次偶然的邂逅

definition: to experience something, especially something unpleasant or difficult, while you are trying to do something else
example: We encountered a number of difficulties in the first week.
definition_zh: 在尝试做别的事情时，体验某件事，尤其是不愉快或困难的事情
example_zh: 我们在第一周遇到了不少困难。

definition: to succeed in attracting and keeping somebody’s attention and interest
example: It is a movie that engages both the mind and the eye.
definition_zh: 成功吸引并保持某人的注意力和兴趣
example_zh: 这是一部既能吸引人心又能触动人心的电影。

definition: to increase or further improve the good quality, value or status of somebody/something
example: This is an opportunity to enhance the reputation of the company.
definition_zh: 提高或进一步提升某人/某物的良好质量、价值或地位
example_zh: 这是一个提升公司声誉的机会。

definition: giving pleasure
example: an enjoyable weekend/experience
definition_zh: 带来快乐
example_zh: 一个愉快的周末/体验

definition: an official process to find out the cause of something or to find out information about something
example: a murder enquiry
definition_zh: 一个官方程序，用于查明某事的成因或获取有关某事的信息
example_zh: 谋杀调查

definition: to make sure that something happens or is definite
example: ensure something, We are working to ensure the safety of people in the city.
definition_zh: 以确保某件事发生或确定
example_zh: 确保一些事情，我们正在努力保障城市居民的安全。

definition: that you enjoy watching, listening to, doing or experiencing
example: an entertaining speech/evening
definition_zh: 你喜欢观看、聆听、做或体验的
example_zh: 一场有趣的演讲/夜晚

definition: a strong feeling of excitement and interest in something and a desire to become involved in it
example: Her voice was full of enthusiasm.
definition_zh: 对某件事感到强烈的兴奋和兴趣，并渴望参与其中
example_zh: 她的声音充满了热情。

definition: feeling or showing a lot of excitement and interest about somebody/something
example: an enthusiastic supporter
definition_zh: 对某人或某事表现出强烈的兴奋和兴趣
example_zh: 一位热情的支持者

definition: including everything, everyone or every part
example: The entire village was destroyed.
definition_zh: 包括一切，所有人或每一部分
example_zh: 整个村庄被毁。

definition: in every way possible; completely
example: The experience was entirely new to me.
definition_zh: 以各种可能的方式;完全
example_zh: 这段经历对我来说完全是全新的。

definition: a person who makes money by starting or running businesses, especially when this involves taking financial risks
example: A creative entrepreneur, he was continually dreaming up new projects.
definition_zh: 一个通过创业或经营企业赚钱的人，尤其是在涉及承担财务风险时
example_zh: 作为一名富有创意的企业家，他不断构思新的项目。

definition: a flat paper container used for sending letters in, with a part that you stick down to close it
example: Writing paper and envelopes are provided in your room.
definition_zh: 一个平坦的纸容器，用来寄信，有一个需要插入即可关闭的部分
example_zh: 您的房间内已提供写字纸和信封。

definition: a person or thing of the same quality or with the same status, rights, etc. as another
example: She treats the people who work for her as her equals.
definition_zh: 一个与另一个人或事物具有相同质量或相同的地位、权利等
example_zh: 她把为她工作的人当作平等对待。

definition: to provide yourself/somebody/something with the things that are needed for a particular purpose or activity
example: equip something, to be fully/poorly equipped
definition_zh: 为自己/某人/某物提供实现特定目的或活动所需的物品
example_zh: 装备点东西，让装备完整/装备不足

definition: equal in value, amount, meaning, importance, etc.
example: 250 grams or an equivalent amount in ounces
definition_zh: 价值、数量、意义、重要性等都相等。
example_zh: 250克或等值数量（盎司）

definition: a thing, amount, word, etc. that is equal in value, meaning or purpose to something else
example: Send €20 or the equivalent in your own currency.
definition_zh: 一个在价值、意义或目的上与其他事物相等的事物、数量、词语等
example_zh: 请以您自己的货币发送20欧元或等值金额。

definition: a period of time, usually in history, that is different from other periods because of particular characteristics or events
example: the Victorian/modern/post-war era
definition_zh: 这段时期通常在历史上，因某些特征或事件而与其他时期不同
example_zh: 维多利亚时代/现代/战后时代

definition: when a volcano erupts or burning rocks, smoke, etc. erupt or are erupted, the burning rocks, etc. are thrown out from the volcano
example: The volcano could erupt at any time.
definition_zh: 当火山喷发或燃烧的岩石、烟雾等喷发时，燃烧的岩石等会被从火山中抛出
example_zh: 火山随时可能喷发。

definition: when you think about the true, important or basic nature of somebody/something
example: There are three essentially different ways of tackling the problem.
definition_zh: 当你思考某人/某物的真实、重要或基本本质时
example_zh: 解决这个问题有三种本质上不同的方法。

definition: to start or create an organization, a system, etc. that is meant to last for a long time
example: The committee was established in 1912.
definition_zh: 建立或创建一个组织、系统等，旨在长期存在
example_zh: 该委员会成立于1912年。

definition: an area of land with a lot of houses or factories of the same type on it
example: on an estate, She lives in a tower block on an estate in London.
definition_zh: 一片土地上有许多同类型房屋或工厂
example_zh: 她住在伦敦一处住宅区的一栋高楼里。

definition: a judgement that you make without having the exact details or figures about the size, amount, cost, etc. of something
example: to provide/obtain an estimate
definition_zh: 这是你在没有确切细节或数字的情况下做出的判断，比如对某物的大小、数量、成本等
example_zh: 提供/获取估价

definition: to form an idea of the cost, size, value etc. of something, but without calculating it exactly
example: estimate something, to estimate the cost/value/number of something
definition_zh: 形成对某物成本、规模、价值等的概念，但不精确计算
example_zh: 估算某样东西，用来估算某样东西的成本/价值/数量

definition: moral principles that control or influence a person’s behaviour
example: professional/business/medical ethics
definition_zh: 控制或影响一个人行为的道德原则
example_zh: 职业/商业/医学伦理

definition: connected with beliefs and principles about what is right and wrong
example: ethical issues/standards/questions/dilemmas
definition_zh: 与对错的信念和原则相连
example_zh: 伦理问题/标准/问题/困境

definition: connected with or belonging to a group of people that share a cultural tradition
example: ethnic background/origin
definition_zh: 与共享文化传统的群体有联系或属于
example_zh: 族裔背景/起源

definition: to form an opinion of the amount, value or quality of something after thinking about it carefully
example: evaluate something, The trial will evaluate the effectiveness of the different drugs.
definition_zh: 在认真思考某物的数量、价值或质量后形成判断
example_zh: 评估某些东西，试验将评估不同药物的疗效。

definition: the act of forming an opinion of the amount, value or quality of something after thinking about it carefully
example: an evaluation of the healthcare system
definition_zh: 在认真思考某物的数量、价值或质量后形成判断的行为
example_zh: 对医疗体系的评估

definition: that can be divided exactly by two
example: 4, 6, 8 and 10 are all even numbers.
definition_zh: 可以精确除以二

definition: clear; easily seen
example: The orchestra played with evident enjoyment.
definition_zh: 清晰;一眼就能看见
example_zh: 乐团演奏时明显乐在其中。

definition: enjoying harming others; morally bad and cruel
example: Police described the killer as ‘a desperate and evil man’.
definition_zh: 享受伤害他人;道德上恶劣且残忍
example_zh: 警方形容凶手是“一个绝望且邪恶的人”。

definition: a force that causes bad things to happen; morally bad behaviour
example: the eternal struggle between good and evil
definition_zh: 一种导致坏事发生的力量;道德上的不良行为
example_zh: 善与恶之间的永恒斗争

definition: the slow steady development of plants, animals, etc. during the history of the earth, as they adapt to changes in their environment
example: the evolution of the human species
definition_zh: 植物、动物等在地球历史中缓慢而稳定地发展，它们适应环境变化
example_zh: 人类物种的进化

definition: to develop gradually, especially from a simple to a more complicated form; to develop something in this way
example: evolve (from something) (into something), The idea evolved from a drawing I discovered in the attic.
definition_zh: 逐步发展，尤其是从简单形式发展到更复杂的形式;以这种方式发展某样东西
example_zh: 演变（从某物）（变成某物），这个想法源自我在阁楼发现的一幅画。

definition: a formal written, spoken or practical test, especially at school or college, to see how much you know about a subject, or what you can do
example: successful candidates in GCSE examinations
definition_zh: 正式的笔试、口头或实践测试，尤其是在学校或大学，用来看看你对某门学科了解多少，或者你能做什么
example_zh: GCSE考试的成功考生

definition: to be greater than a particular number or amount
example: The price will not exceed £100.
definition_zh: 大于某个特定数量或金额
example_zh: 价格不会超过100英镑。

definition: a person or thing that is not included in a general statement
example: Most of the buildings in the town are modern, but the church is an exception.
definition_zh: 未包含在一般陈述中的个人或事物
example_zh: 镇上的大多数建筑都是现代建筑，但教堂是个例外。

definition: greater than what seems reasonable or appropriate
example: They complained about the excessive noise coming from the upstairs flat.
definition_zh: 超出合理或适当的程度
example_zh: 他们抱怨楼上公寓传来的噪音太大。

definition: to deliberately not include something in what you are doing or considering
example: The cost of borrowing has been excluded from the inflation figures.
definition_zh: 在你正在做或考虑的事情中，故意不包含某些内容
example_zh: 借款成本已被排除在通胀数据之外。

definition: a reason, either true or invented, that you give to explain or defend your behaviour
example: Late again! What's your excuse this time?
definition_zh: 一个你用来解释或辩护你行为的理由，无论是真实还是虚构的
example_zh: 又迟到了！这次你有什么借口？

definition: to forgive somebody for something that they have done, for example not being polite or making a small mistake
example: excuse something, Please excuse the mess.
definition_zh: 原谅别人做过的事，比如不礼貌或犯了一个小错误
example_zh: 请原谅点什么，请原谅这里的凌乱。

definition: connected with managing a business or an organization, and with making plans and decisions
example: She has an executive position in a finance company.
definition_zh: 与管理企业或组织、制定计划和决策相关
example_zh: 她在一家金融公司担任高管职位。

definition: a person who has an important job as a manager of a company or an organization
example: company/corporate/business/industry executives
definition_zh: 一个担任公司或组织经理重要职责的人
example_zh: 公司/企业/商业/行业高管

definition: an object or a collection of objects put in a public place, for example a museum, so that people can see it
example: The museum contains some interesting exhibits on Spanish rural life.
definition_zh: 一件物品或一组物品被放置在公共场所，比如博物馆，以便人们看到它
example_zh: 博物馆收藏了一些关于西班牙乡村生活的有趣展品。

definition: to show something in a public place for people to enjoy or to give them information
example: exhibit something (at/in…), They will be exhibiting their new designs at the trade fairs.
definition_zh: 在公共场所展示某物供人们欣赏或提供信息
example_zh: 展出一些东西（at/in...），他们将在贸易展上展示他们的新设计。

definition: the state or fact of being real or living or of being present
example: I was unaware of his existence until today.
definition_zh: 真实、活着或存在的状态或事实
example_zh: 直到今天我才知道他的存在。

definition: a way out of a public building or vehicle
example: Where's the exit?
definition_zh: 公共建筑或车辆的逃生通道
example_zh: 出口在哪里？

definition: from or in another country, especially a tropical one; seeming exciting and unusual because it seems to be connected with foreign countries
example: brightly-coloured exotic flowers/plants/birds
definition_zh: 来自或来自其他国家，尤其是热带国家;看起来既令人兴奋又不寻常，因为它似乎与外国有关
example_zh: 色彩鲜艳的异国花卉/植物/鸟类

definition: an act of increasing or making something increase in size, amount or importance
example: a period of rapid economic expansion
definition_zh: 增加或使某物在体积、数量或重要性上增加的行为
example_zh: 经济快速扩张的时期

definition: a belief that something will happen because it is likely
example: expectation of something, We are confident in our expectation of a full recovery.
definition_zh: 一种相信某件事会发生的信念，因为它很可能会发生
example_zh: 对某种期待，我们对完全康复的期待充满信心。

definition: the money that you spend on something
example: The garden was transformed at great expense.
definition_zh: 你花在某样东西上的钱
example_zh: 花园经过改造，花费巨大。

definition: expert knowledge or skill in a particular subject, activity or job
example: professional/scientific/technical, etc. expertise
definition_zh: 在特定学科、活动或工作方面的专业知识或技能
example_zh: 专业/科学/技术等专长

definition: to treat a person or situation as an opportunity to gain an advantage for yourself
example: He exploited his father's name to get himself a job.
definition_zh: 把一个人或情境当作为自己争取优势的机会
example_zh: 他利用父亲的名声谋取工作。

definition: the act of travelling through a place in order to find out about it or look for something in it
example: Budgets for space exploration have been cut back.
definition_zh: 穿梭于一个地方，以了解它或寻找其中的东西的行为
example_zh: 太空探索的预算被削减了。

definition: to show something that is usually hidden
example: expose something, He smiled suddenly, exposing a set of amazingly white teeth.
definition_zh: 展示通常隐藏的内容
example_zh: 露出什么，“他突然笑了，露出一口异常洁白的牙齿。

definition: the state of being in a place or situation where there is no protection from something harmful or unpleasant
example: prolonged exposure to harmful radiation
definition_zh: 处于一个没有任何保护免受有害或不愉快事物保护的状态
example_zh: 长期暴露于有害辐射

definition: to make something longer or larger
example: to extend a fence/road/house
definition_zh: 让某样东西变长或更大
example_zh: 延伸围栏/道路/房屋

definition: the act of increasing the area of activity, group of people, etc. that is affected by something
example: the extension of new technology into developing countries
definition_zh: 扩大受某影响的活动范围、人群等的行为
example_zh: 将新技术推广到发展中国家

definition: covering a large area; great in amount
example: The house has extensive grounds.
definition_zh: 覆盖面积大;数量巨大
example_zh: 这座宅邸拥有广阔的庭院。

definition: in a way that covers a large area
example: She has travelled extensively.
definition_zh: 以覆盖大范围的方式
example_zh: 她曾广泛旅行。

definition: how large, important, serious, etc. something is
example: It is difficult to assess the full extent of the damage.
definition_zh: 某件事有多大、多重要、多严重等等
example_zh: 评估损害的全部程度是很难的。

definition: connected with or located on the outside of something/somebody
example: the external walls of the building
definition_zh: 与某物/某人相连或位于外部
example_zh: 建筑的外墙

definition: a short passage from a book, piece of music, etc. that gives you an idea of what the whole thing is like
example: The following extract is taken from her new novel.
definition_zh: 一小段书里的一段、一段音乐之类的片段，能让你大致了解整个过程是什么样的
example_zh: 以下摘录自她的新小说。

definition: unexpected, surprising or strange
example: What an extraordinary thing to say!
definition_zh: 出乎意料、令人惊讶或奇怪
example_zh: 真是非凡的话！

definition: a feeling, situation, way of behaving, etc. that is as different as possible from another or is opposite to it
example: extremes of love and hate
definition_zh: 一种感觉、情境、行为方式等，尽可能与另一种不同或相反
example_zh: 爱与恨的极端

definition: material made by weaving wool, cotton, silk, etc., used for making clothes, curtains, etc. and for covering furniture
example: They sell a wide variety of printed cotton fabric.
definition_zh: 由羊毛、棉、丝等织造的材料，用于制作服装、窗帘等以及覆盖家具
example_zh: 他们出售各种印花棉布。

definition: extremely good
example: They put on a fabulous performance.
definition_zh: 极好
example_zh: 他们表演得非常精彩。

definition: buildings, services, equipment, etc. that are provided for a particular purpose
example: leisure/sports facilities
definition_zh: 为特定目的而提供的建筑物、服务、设备等
example_zh: 休闲/体育设施

definition: not successful
example: a failed writer
definition_zh: 未成功
example_zh: 一个失败的作家

definition: lack of success in doing or achieving something
example: The success or failure of the plan depends on you.
definition_zh: 在做某事或实现某事上缺乏成功
example_zh: 计划的成败取决于你。

definition: trust in somebody’s ability or knowledge; trust that somebody/something will do what has been promised
example: If the company can retain its customers' faith, it could become the market leader.
definition_zh: 信任某人的能力或知识;相信某人/某物会兑现承诺
example_zh: 如果公司能够赢得客户的信任，它有望成为市场领导者。

definition: not what somebody claims it is; appearing to be something it is not
example: There were a few stalls selling fake designer clothing.
definition_zh: 不是别人声称的样子;看起来像其实不是的东西
example_zh: 有几个摊位卖假名牌服装。

definition: the state of being known and talked about by many people
example: to achieve/win instant fame
definition_zh: 被许多人所知晓、谈论的状态
example_zh: 为了获得/赢得瞬间的名声

definition: a pleasant situation that you imagine but that is unlikely to happen
example: He spoke of his childhood fantasies about becoming a famous football player.
definition_zh: 一个你想象中美好但不太可能发生的情景
example_zh: 他谈到了自己童年时幻想成为一名著名橄榄球运动员的梦想。

definition: the money that you pay to travel by bus, plane, taxi, etc.
example: bus/taxi fares
definition_zh: 你为乘坐公交、飞机、出租车等交通支付的费用。
example_zh: 公交/出租车票价

definition: the responsibility for something wrong that has happened or been done
example: Why should I say sorry when it's not my fault?
definition_zh: 对已经发生或被做过的错误行为的责任
example_zh: 既然不是我的错，我为什么要道歉？

definition: to prefer one system, plan, way of doing something, etc. to another
example: favour something, Many countries favour a presidential system of government.
definition_zh: 偏好某一种系统、计划、做事方式等，而不是另一种
example_zh: 支持某项政策，许多国家支持总统制政府。

definition: one of the many soft light parts covering a bird’s body
example: a peacock feather
definition_zh: 覆盖鸟体的众多柔光部分之一
example_zh: 一根孔雀羽毛

definition: having a system of government in which the individual states of a country have control over their own affairs, but are controlled by a central government for national decisions, etc.
example: a federal republic
definition_zh: 即拥有一种政府体系，各国各州掌控自身事务，但在国家决策等方面由中央政府控制。
example_zh: 联邦共和国

definition: an amount of money that you pay for professional advice or services
example: Employees are reimbursed for any legal fees incurred when they relocate.
definition_zh: 您为专业咨询或服务支付的金额
example_zh: 员工搬迁时产生的任何法律费用都会获得报销。

definition: a meal of milk for a young baby; a meal for an animal
example: her morning feed
definition_zh: 为年幼婴儿准备的一餐牛奶;为动物准备的一餐
example_zh: 她的早晨喂食

definition: advice, criticism or information about how good or useful something or somebody’s work is
example: customer/user feedback
definition_zh: 关于某件作品或某人作品有多好或有多有用，提供建议、批评或信息
example_zh: 客户/用户反馈

definition: the feeling you get when you touch something or are touched
example: You can tell it's silk by the feel.
definition_zh: 当你触摸某物或被触碰时的那种感觉
example_zh: 你能从手感判断它是丝绸。

definition: used to describe somebody who is the same as you in some way, or in the same situation
example: fellow citizens/students
definition_zh: 用来形容在某种方面与你相似或处于相同情境的人
example_zh: 同胞/学生

definition: a medical condition in which a person has a temperature that is higher than normal
example: He has a high fever.
definition_zh: 一种医疗状况，指一个人体温高于正常情况
example_zh: 他发高烧。

definition: to be part of a process, situation, etc. especially an important part
example: My feelings about the matter didn't seem to figure at all.
definition_zh: 成为某个过程、情境等的一部分，尤其是重要的一环
example_zh: 我对这件事的感受似乎一点都没被放在心上。

definition: to put and keep paper documents in a particular place and in a particular order so that you can find them easily; to put a paper document in a box, file, etc.
example: file something (+ adv./prep.), The forms should be filed alphabetically.
definition_zh: 将纸质文件按特定位置和顺序放置，以便你轻松找到;将纸质文件放入盒子、文件夹等。
example_zh: 提交某项文件（+ 进度/准备），表格应按字母顺序归档。

definition: money used to run a business, an activity or a project
example: The project will only go ahead if they can raise the necessary finance.
definition_zh: 用于经营企业、活动或项目的资金
example_zh: 只有在他们筹集到必要资金的情况下，这个项目才会继续推进。

definition: to provide money for a project
example: finance something, He took a job to finance his stay in Germany.
definition_zh: 为项目提供资金
example_zh: 他找了份工作来资助他在德国的逗留。

definition: information that is discovered as the result of research into something
example: Our research findings indicate that pregnant women benefit from this treatment.
definition_zh: 通过对某项研究发现的信息
example_zh: 我们的研究结果表明，孕妇从这种治疗中受益。

definition: a person whose job is to put out fires
example: Firefighters were called to a house in Summertown.
definition_zh: 一个工作是扑灭火灾的人
example_zh: 消防员被召到萨默敦的一处住宅。

definition: a small device containing powder that burns or explodes and produces bright coloured lights and loud noises, used especially at celebrations
example: (British English), to let off a few fireworks
definition_zh: 一种装有粉末的小装置，可以燃烧或爆炸，产生明亮的光芒和响亮的噪音，特别用于庆祝活动
example_zh: （英式英语），放几支烟花

definition: fairly hard; not easy to press into a different shape
example: a firm bed/mattress
definition_zh: 相当硬;很难按成不同的形状
example_zh: 硬床/床垫

definition: a business or company
example: a law/consulting/research firm
definition_zh: 企业或公司
example_zh: 一家法律/咨询/研究公司

definition: in a strong or definite way
example: ‘I can manage,’ she said firmly.
definition_zh: 以强烈或明确的方式
example_zh: “我能应付，”她坚定地说。

definition: a solution to a problem, especially an easy or temporary one
example: Luckily there is an easy fix.
definition_zh: 问题的解决方案，尤其是简单或暂时的解决方案
example_zh: 幸运的是，有个简单的解决办法。

definition: a hot bright stream of burning gas that comes from something that is on fire
example: the tiny yellow flame of a match
definition_zh: 一股炽热明亮的燃烧气体流，来自着火的东西
example_zh: 那团小小的黄色火柴

definition: a sudden bright light that shines for a moment and then disappears
example: a flash of lightning
definition_zh: 一道突如其来的明亮光芒，闪烁了一瞬又消失
example_zh: 一道闪电

definition: to shine very brightly for a short time; to make something shine in this way
example: Lightning flashed in the distance.
definition_zh: 短暂地闪耀;让某物以这种方式闪耀
example_zh: 远处闪电划过。

definition: how food or drink tastes
example: The tomatoes give extra flavour to the sauce.
definition_zh: 食物或饮料的味道
example_zh: 番茄为酱汁增添了额外的风味。

definition: able to change to suit new conditions or situations
example: a more flexible approach
definition_zh: 能够根据新的条件或情况进行调整
example_zh: 更灵活的方法

definition: to move slowly on water or in the air
example: A group of swans floated by.
definition_zh: 在水面或空中缓慢移动
example_zh: 一群天鹅从旁边飘过。

definition: a part of something, especially cloth, that is folded or hangs as if it had been folded
example: the folds of her dress
definition_zh: 某物的部分，尤其是布料，折叠或垂挂，好像被折叠过一样
example_zh: 她裙子的褶皱

definition: that can be folded, so that it can be carried or stored in a small space
example: a folding chair/bike/knife
definition_zh: 可以折叠，便于携带或存放在一个小空间里
example_zh: 折叠椅/自行车/刀

definition: after or as a result of a particular event
example: He took charge of the family business following his father's death.
definition_zh: 在某一特定事件之后或因某一事件而发生
example_zh: 父亲去世后，他接管了家族企业。

definition: having warm or loving feelings for somebody, especially somebody you have known for a long time
example: Over the years, I have grown quite fond of her.
definition_zh: 对某人产生温暖或充满爱意的人，尤其是认识很久的人
example_zh: 这些年来，我对她越来越喜欢上了。

definition: a person who you think behaves or speaks in a way that lacks intelligence or good judgement
example: Don't be such a fool!
definition_zh: 你认为那种行为或说话缺乏智慧或判断力的人
example_zh: 别这么傻！

definition: to order somebody not to do something; to order that something must not be done
example: forbid somebody (from doing something), He forbade them from mentioning the subject again.
definition_zh: 命令某人不做某事;命令某事绝不可做
example_zh: 禁止某人（做某事），他禁止他们再提起这个话题。

definition: a statement about what will happen in the future, based on information that is available now
example: The sales forecasts are encouraging.
definition_zh: 基于现有信息，关于未来将会发生什么的声明
example_zh: 销售预测令人鼓舞。

definition: to say what you think will happen in the future based on information that you have now
example: forecast something, Experts are forecasting a recovery in the economy.
definition_zh: 根据你现在掌握的信息，说出你认为未来会发生什么
example_zh: 预测一些东西，专家们预测经济将复苏。

definition: to stop feeling angry with somebody who has done something to harm, annoy or upset you; to stop feeling angry with yourself
example: forgive somebody, Can you ever forgive me?
definition_zh: 停止对那些伤害、惹恼或让你不快的人感到愤怒;停止对自己感到愤怒
example_zh: 原谅别人，你能原谅我吗？

definition: the general arrangement, plan, design, etc. of something
example: The format of the new quiz show has proved popular.
definition_zh: 某物的总体布局、计划、设计等
example_zh: 新问答节目的形式非常受欢迎。

definition: the action of forming something; the process of being formed
example: the formation of a new government
definition_zh: 形成某物的动作;被塑造的过程
example_zh: 新政府的组建

definition: that existed in earlier times
example: This fine ruin was, in former times, a royal castle.
definition_zh: 存在于较早时期的
example_zh: 这座精美的废墟，在过去曾是一座皇家城堡。

definition: in the past
example: Namibia, formerly known as South West Africa
definition_zh: 在过去
example_zh: 纳米比亚，原名西南非洲

definition: having or bringing an advantage, an opportunity, a piece of good luck, etc.
example: Remember those less fortunate than yourselves.
definition_zh: 拥有或带来优势、机会、一丝好运等等。
example_zh: 记住那些比你们更不幸的人。

definition: a large amount of money
example: He made a fortune in real estate.
definition_zh: 一大笔钱
example_zh: 他在房地产上赚了大钱。

definition: an event or medium where people can exchange opinions and ideas on a particular issue; a meeting organized for this purpose
example: forum (on something), to hold an international forum on drug abuse
definition_zh: 一个活动或媒介，供人们就某一特定议题交换意见和想法;为此目的举办的会议
example_zh: 论坛（关于某件事），举办一个关于毒品滥用的国际论坛

definition: directed or moving towards the front
example: The door opened, blocking his forward movement.
definition_zh: 向前移动或向前移动
example_zh: 门打开，挡住了他向前的前进。

definition: the parts of a dead animal or a plant that have become hard and turned into rock
example: fossils over two million years old
definition_zh: 死去的动物或植物的部分变硬并变成了岩石
example_zh: 超过两百万年前的化石

definition: to start something, such as an organization or an institution, especially by providing money
example: to found a club/company/school
definition_zh: 要创办一些事情，比如一个组织或机构，尤其是通过提供资金
example_zh: 创办俱乐部/公司/学校

definition: a principle, an idea or a fact that something is based on and that it grows from
example: Respect and friendship provide a solid foundation for marriage.
definition_zh: 一个原则、一个想法或一个事实，它是某件事的基础，并且是从中发展出来的
example_zh: 尊重和友谊为婚姻提供了坚实的基础。

definition: a person who starts an organization, institution, etc. or causes something to be built
example: the founder and president of the company
definition_zh: 一个创办组织、机构等或推动某物建立的人
example_zh: 公司的创始人兼总裁

definition: a small part or amount of something
example: Only a small fraction of a bank's total deposits will be withdrawn at any one time.
definition_zh: 某物的一小部分或部分
example_zh: 银行总存款中，任何时候只有极小一部分会被提取。

definition: a small part of something that has broken off or comes from something larger
example: fragment (of something), Police found fragments of glass near the scene.
definition_zh: 一个断裂或来自更大事物的一小部分
example_zh: 警方在现场附近发现了玻璃碎片。

definition: the parts of a building or an object that support its weight and give it shape
example: built on a wooden framework
definition_zh: 建筑物或物体中支撑其重量并赋予其形状的部分
example_zh: 建于木制框架之上

definition: the crime of cheating somebody in order to get money or goods illegally
example: She was charged with credit card fraud.
definition_zh: 欺骗他人以非法获取金钱或商品的犯罪
example_zh: 她被控信用卡欺诈。

definition: to allow somebody to leave prison or somewhere they have been kept against their will
example: free somebody, The hijackers agreed to free a further ten hostages.
definition_zh: 允许某人离开监狱或被强行关押的地方
example_zh: 救人，劫机者同意再释放十名人质。

definition: the power or right to do or say what you want without anyone stopping you
example: to defend/protect academic freedom
definition_zh: 拥有权力或权利，可以做或说任何你想做的话，而没有任何人阻止你
example_zh: 捍卫/保护学术自由

definition: without anyone trying to prevent or control something
example: the country’s first freely elected president
definition_zh: 没有任何人试图阻止或控制某件事
example_zh: 该国首位自由选举产生的总统

definition: the rate at which something happens or is repeated
example: Fatal road accidents have decreased in frequency over recent years.
definition_zh: 某件事发生或重复发生的速率
example_zh: 近年来，致命交通事故的发生率有所下降。

definition: happening or doing something often
example: He is a frequent visitor to this country.
definition_zh: 经常发生或做某事
example_zh: 他经常来访这个国家。

definition: to supply something with material that can be burnt to produce heat or power
example: Uranium is used to fuel nuclear plants.
definition_zh: 为某物提供可燃烧以产生热量或电力的材料
example_zh: 铀被用于核电站的燃料。

definition: to do or achieve what was hoped for or expected
example: to fulfil your dream/ambition/potential
definition_zh: 去做或实现人们所期望或期望的事
example_zh: 为了实现你的梦想/抱负/潜力

definition: for all the hours of a week during which people normally work or study, rather than just for a part of it
example: students in full-time education
definition_zh: 针对人们通常工作或学习的每周所有时间，而不仅仅是部分时间
example_zh: 全日制教育学生

definition: for all the hours of a week during which people normally work or study, rather than just for a part of it
example: students in full-time education
definition_zh: 针对人们通常工作或学习的每周所有时间，而不仅仅是部分时间
example_zh: 全日制教育学生

definition: completely
example: I fully understand your motives.
definition_zh: 完全
example_zh: 我完全理解你的动机。

definition: to work in the correct way
example: We now have a functioning shower.
definition_zh: 以正确的方式工作
example_zh: 我们现在有了一个正常运作的淋浴间。

definition: an amount of money that has been saved or has been made available for a particular purpose
example: a disaster relief fund
definition_zh: 为特定目的储备或提供的一笔资金
example_zh: 灾难救助基金

definition: to provide money for something, usually something official
example: Who is funding this research?
definition_zh: 为某些事情提供资金，通常是官方的
example_zh: 谁在资助这项研究？

definition: serious and very important; affecting the most central and important parts of something
example: the fundamental principles of scientific method
definition_zh: 严肃且极其重要;影响某事最核心和最重要的部分
example_zh: 科学方法的基本原则

definition: in every way that is important; completely
example: The two approaches are fundamentally different.
definition_zh: 在所有重要的方面;完全
example_zh: 这两种方法本质上是不同的。

definition: money for a particular purpose; the act of providing money for such a purpose
example: federal/state funding
definition_zh: 为特定目的提供资金;为该目的提供资金的行为
example_zh: 联邦/州资助

definition: very angry
example: Their incompetence made me furious.
definition_zh: 非常生气
example_zh: 他们的无能让我非常愤怒。

definition: in addition to what has just been stated. Furthermore is used especially to add a point to an argument.
example: He said he had not discussed the matter with her. Furthermore, he had not even contacted her.
definition_zh: 除了刚才所说的之外。此外，“进一步”特别用来为论点加点。
example_zh: 他说自己没有和她讨论过此事。此外，他甚至没有联系过她。

definition: an increase in the amount of something, especially in wealth or weight
example: The opposition made unexpected gains in the last election.
definition_zh: 某物的数量增加，尤其是财富或体重的增加
example_zh: 反对派在上次选举中取得了意想不到的进展。

definition: to obtain or win something, especially something that you need or want
example: gain something, They managed to gain access to secret files.
definition_zh: 为了获得或赢得某样东西，尤其是你需要或想要的东西
example_zh: 他们获得了一些东西，成功获得了机密文件的访问权限。

definition: playing computer games
example: online/mobile/console gaming
definition_zh: 玩电脑游戏
example_zh: 在线/移动/主机游戏

definition: an organized group of criminals
example: criminal gangs
definition_zh: 一个有组织的犯罪集团
example_zh: 犯罪团伙

definition: sexually attracted to people of the same sex
example: gay men
definition_zh: 对同性产生性吸引
example_zh: 男同性恋

definition: the fact of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences, rather than differences in biology; members of a particular gender as a group
example: issues of class, race and gender
definition_zh: 男性或女性的身份，尤其是在考虑社会和文化差异而非生物学差异时;群体中特定性别的成员
example_zh: 阶级、种族与性别问题

definition: a unit inside a cell that controls a particular quality in a living thing that has been passed on from its parents
example: a dominant/recessive gene
definition_zh: 细胞内的一个单元，控制着生物体内某种特定品质，这种品质是从父母那里遗传下来的
example_zh: 显性/隐性基因

definition: to produce energy, especially electricity
example: The wind turbines are used to generate electricity.
definition_zh: 用于生产能源，尤其是电力
example_zh: 风力发电机用于发电。

definition: connected with genes (= the units in the cells of a living thing that control its physical characteristics) or genetics (= the study of genes)
example: genetic and environmental factors
definition_zh: 与基因（=控制其物理特征的细胞单元）或遗传学（=基因研究）相关
example_zh: 遗传和环境因素

definition: unusually great intelligence, skill or artistic ability
example: the genius of Shakespeare
definition_zh: 异常卓越的智力、技巧或艺术天赋
example_zh: 莎士比亚的天才

definition: a particular type or style of literature, art, film or music that you can recognize because of its special features
example: literary/musical genres
definition_zh: 一种你能认出的文学、艺术、电影或音乐的特定类型或风格，因其特殊之处而被你认出
example_zh: 文学/音乐类型

definition: real; exactly what it appears to be; not artificial
example: Is the painting a genuine Picasso?
definition_zh: 真实;完全如其所见;非人工
example_zh: 这幅画是真正的毕加索吗？

definition: truly; in a way that is exactly what it appears to be and is not artificial
example: There are some genuinely funny moments in the film.
definition_zh: 真的;以一种完全符合表面看去的方式，而不是人为的
example_zh: 电影中确实有一些真正有趣的时刻。

definition: a movement that you make with your hands, your head or your face to show a particular meaning
example: He made a rude gesture at the driver of the other car.
definition_zh: 你用手、头或脸做出的动作，用来表达某种特定意义
example_zh: 他朝另一辆车的司机做了个粗鲁的手势。

definition: a performance by musicians playing popular music or jazz in front of an audience; a similar performance by a comedian
example: They're doing a gig in Boston tonight.
definition_zh: 音乐家在观众面前演奏流行音乐或爵士乐的表演;喜剧演员类似的表演
example_zh: 他们今晚在波士顿有演出。

definition: the process by which businesses and cultures become connected worldwide
example: Globalization has increased international trade.
definition_zh: 企业与文化在全球范围内相互连接的过程
example_zh: 全球化推动了国际贸易。

definition: the world (used especially to emphasize its size)
example: tourists from every corner of the globe
definition_zh: 世界（特别用来强调其大小）
example_zh: 来自全球各地的游客

definition: made of gold
example: a golden crown
definition_zh: 金制
example_zh: 一顶金色王冠

definition: the quality of being good
example: the essential goodness of human nature
definition_zh: 优秀的品质
example_zh: 人性本质上的善良

definition: very beautiful and attractive; giving great pleasure
example: a gorgeous girl/man
definition_zh: 非常美丽且吸引人;带来极大的愉悦
example_zh: 一个漂亮的女孩/男人

definition: to legally control a country or its people and be responsible for introducing new laws, organizing public services, etc.
example: The country is governed by elected representatives of the people.
definition_zh: 对一个国家或其人民进行法律控制，并负责制定新法律、组织公共服务等。
example_zh: 该国由民选代表治理。

definition: a person who is the official head of a country or region that is governed by another country
example: the former governor of the colony
definition_zh: 指由另一国统治的国家或地区的官方首脑
example_zh: 殖民地前总督

definition: to take or hold somebody/something with your hand suddenly or roughly
example: grab somebody/something, She grabbed his arm as he got up to leave.
definition_zh: 突然或粗暴地用手抓住或抓住某人/某物
example_zh: 抓住某个人/什么，她抓住他的手臂，正好他起身准备离开。

definition: to give a grade to a student or to a piece of their written work
example: grade somebody/something, I spent all weekend grading papers.
definition_zh: 给学生或其书面作品评分
example_zh: 给某人/某人批改，我整个周末都在批改作业。

definition: slowly, over a long period of time
example: to gradually increase/decrease
definition_zh: 慢慢地，在很长的时间里
example_zh: 逐步增加/减少

definition: impressive and large or important
example: It's not a very grand house.
definition_zh: 令人印象深刻且规模宏大或重要
example_zh: 这房子并不豪华。

definition: a sum of money that is given by the government or by another organization to be used for a particular purpose
example: government/federal grants
definition_zh: 由政府或其他组织提供用于特定目的的资金
example_zh: 政府/联邦拨款

definition: to agree to give somebody what they ask for, especially formal or legal permission to do something
example: grant something, My request was granted.
definition_zh: 同意给予某人所要求的，尤其是正式或法律上的许可去做某件事
example_zh: 给点什么，我的请求已经答应了。

definition: connected with drawings and design, especially in the production of books, magazines, websites, etc.
example: graphic design
definition_zh: 与绘图和设计相关，尤其是在书籍、杂志、网站等制作方面。
example_zh: 平面设计

definition: designs, drawings or pictures that are used especially in the production of books, magazines, websites, etc.
example: Text and graphics are prepared separately and then combined.
definition_zh: 设计、图纸或图片，尤其用于书籍、杂志、网站等制作。
example_zh: 文本和图形分别准备，然后合并。

definition: very much
example: People's reaction to the film has varied greatly.
definition_zh: 非常喜欢
example_zh: 人们对这部电影的反应差异很大。

definition: a building with glass walls and a glass roof used for growing plants
example: They grow tomatoes in a greenhouse.
definition_zh: 一座有玻璃墙和玻璃屋顶的建筑，用于种植植物
example_zh: 他们在温室里种番茄。

definition: a shop that sells food and other things used in the home. In American English ‘grocery store’ is often used to mean ‘supermarket’.
example: the corner grocery store
definition_zh: 一家销售食品及其他家庭用品的商店。在美式英语中，“grocery store”常被用来指代“超市”。
example_zh: 街角杂货店

definition: a formal promise that you will do something or that something will happen
example: They are demanding certain guarantees before they sign the treaty.
definition_zh: 正式承诺你会做某件事，或者某事会发生
example_zh: 他们要求在签署条约之前获得一定的保障。

definition: to promise to do something; to promise something will happen
example: guarantee something, Basic human rights, including freedom of speech, are now guaranteed.
definition_zh: 承诺要做点什么;承诺一定会发生什么
example_zh: 保障某些东西，基本人权，包括言论自由，现在已经得到保障。

definition: a set of rules or instructions that are given by an official organization telling you how to do something, especially something difficult
example: The government has drawn up guidelines for schools during the pandemic.
definition_zh: 这是官方机构给出的一套规则或说明，告诉你如何做某件事，尤其是一些困难的事情
example_zh: 政府已制定了疫情期间学校的指导方针。

definition: the place where a particular type of animal or plant is normally found
example: The panda's natural habitat is the bamboo forest.
definition_zh: 特定类型的动植物通常出现的地点
example_zh: 熊猫的自然栖息地是竹林。

definition: the part of a door, window, etc. that you use to open it
example: She turned the handle and opened the door.
definition_zh: 你用来打开门、窗等的部分
example_zh: 她转动门把手，打开了门。

definition: to deal with a situation, a person, an area of work or a strong emotion
example: handle something/somebody, A new man was appointed to handle the crisis.
definition_zh: 应对一个情境、一个人、一个工作领域或强烈情绪
example_zh: 处理某件事/某人，一个新人被任命来处理这场危机。

definition: an area of water on the coast, protected from the open sea by strong walls, where ships can shelter
example: Several boats lay at anchor in the harbour.
definition_zh: 一片沿海水域，由坚固的城墙保护，船只可以在此避风港
example_zh: 港内停泊着几艘船。

definition: damage or injury that is caused by a person or an event
example: He would never frighten anyone or cause them any harm.
definition_zh: 由个人或事件造成的损害或伤害
example_zh: 他绝不会吓唬任何人，也不会伤害任何人。

definition: to hurt or injure somebody or to damage something
example: He would never harm anyone.
definition_zh: 伤害或伤害他人或损坏某物
example_zh: 他绝不会伤害任何人。

definition: causing damage or injury to somebody/something, especially to a person’s health or to the environment
example: the harmful effects of alcohol
definition_zh: 对某人或某物造成损害或伤害，尤其是对个人健康或环境造成伤害
example_zh: 酒精的有害影响

definition: a place from which an organization or a military operation is controlled; the people who work there
example: The firm’s headquarters is/are in London.
definition_zh: 一个组织或军事行动从那里受控制的地点;在那里工作的人员
example_zh: 公司的总部位于伦敦。

definition: to become healthy again; to make something healthy again
example: It took a long time for the wounds to heal.
definition_zh: 重新变得健康;重新创造健康的东西
example_zh: 伤口花了很长时间才愈合。

definition: the service of providing medical care
example: the costs of healthcare for the elderly
definition_zh: 提供医疗服务
example_zh: 老年人医疗保健费用

definition: the ability to hear
example: Her hearing is poor.
definition_zh: 听觉能力
example_zh: 她的听力很差。

definition: the place believed to be the home of God where good people go when they die, sometimes imagined to be in the sky
example: the kingdom of heaven
definition_zh: 被认为是上帝之家的地方，好人死后会去那里，有时被想象成在天空中
example_zh: 天国

definition: the back part of the foot below the ankle
example: Apply the cream to dry, cracked heels before bed.
definition_zh: 脚踝以下的后部
example_zh: 睡前将乳膏涂抹在干燥、龟裂的脚跟上。

definition: the place believed to be the home of devils and where bad people go after death
example: He was terrified of going to hell when he died.
definition_zh: 被认为是恶魔的家园，坏人死后会去的地方
example_zh: 他死的时候非常害怕下地狱。

definition: a type of hard hat that protects the head, worn, for example, by a police officer, a soldier or a person riding a bike or motorbike or playing some sports
example: Police in riot helmets lined the streets.
definition_zh: 一种保护头部的安全帽，例如警察、士兵、骑自行车、摩托车或进行运动的人佩戴
example_zh: 戴防暴头盔的警察排在街道两旁。

definition: for this reason
example: We suspect they are trying to hide something, hence the need for an independent inquiry.
definition_zh: 正因如此
example_zh: 我们怀疑他们在试图隐瞒某些事情，因此需要进行独立调查。

definition: a plant whose leaves, flowers or seeds are used to add taste to food, in medicines or for their pleasant smell. parsley, mint and oregano are all herbs.
example: a herb garden
definition_zh: 一种植物，其叶子、花朵或种子被用来为食物增添味道、用于药材或增添宜人的香气。欧芹、薄荷和牛至都是香草。
example_zh: 一个香草园

definition: to be slow to speak or act because you feel uncertain or nervous
example: She hesitated before replying.
definition_zh: 因为感到不确定或紧张而说话或行动迟缓
example_zh: 她犹豫了一下才回答。

definition: something that is hidden is kept or located in a place where it cannot be seen
example: Hidden dangers lurk in the ocean depths.
definition_zh: 隐藏的东西被保存或安置在看不见的地方
example_zh: 隐藏的危险潜伏在海洋深处。

definition: the highest level or number
example: to hit/reach a high
definition_zh: 最高级别或最高数字
example_zh: 达到/达到高峰

definition: a main road for travelling long distances, especially one connecting and going through cities and towns
example: Plans were being made for the construction of a new interstate highway system.
definition_zh: 一条长途旅行的主要道路，尤其是连接并穿过城市和城镇的道路
example_zh: 当时正在制定建设新州际公路系统的计划。

definition: extremely funny
example: a hilarious joke/story
definition_zh: 极其有趣
example_zh: 一个爆笑的笑话/故事

definition: the area at either side of the body between the top of the leg and the middle part of the body; the joint at the top of the leg that connects it with the top part of the body
example: She stood with her hands on her hips.
definition_zh: 身体两侧，腿上方与身体中段之间的区域;连接腿部与身体上半部的关节
example_zh: 她双手叉腰站着。

definition: the act of paying to use something for a short time
example: a hire car
definition_zh: 为短时间使用某物付费的行为
example_zh: 一辆租车

definition: a person who studies or writes about history; an expert in history
example: No serious historian today accepts this theory.
definition_zh: 研究或撰写历史的人;历史专家
example_zh: 如今没有严肃的历史学家接受这一理论。

definition: the action of holding somebody/something; the way you are holding somebody/something
example: hold on somebody/something, His hold on her arm tightened.
definition_zh: 抱住某人/某物的动作;你抱着某人/某物的方式
example_zh: “抓住某个人/某物”，他握着她手臂的力道更紧了。

definition: having a hole or empty space inside
example: a hollow ball/centre/tube/tree
definition_zh: 内部有洞或空隙
example_zh: 空心球/中心/管/树

definition: connected with God or a particular religion
example: the Holy Bible
definition_zh: 与上帝或特定宗教有关
example_zh: 圣经

definition: having no home, and therefore typically living on the streets
example: The scheme has been set up to help homeless people.
definition_zh: 他们没有家，因此通常流落街头。
example_zh: 该计划旨在帮助无家可归者。

definition: the quality of being honest
example: She answered all my questions with her usual honesty.
definition_zh: 诚实的品质
example_zh: 她一如既往地坦诚回答了我所有的问题。

definition: great respect for somebody
example: the guest of honour (= the most important one)
definition_zh: 对某人的极大尊重
example_zh: 主宾（= 最重要的一位）

definition: to do something that shows great respect for somebody/something
example: honour somebody/something, our honoured guests
definition_zh: 做一件能表达对某人/某事极大尊重的事
example_zh: 尊敬的客人，敬请某人/某物

definition: a curved piece of metal, plastic or wire for hanging things on, catching fish with, etc.
example: a picture/curtain/coat hook
definition_zh: 一种弯曲的金属片、塑料或铁丝，用来挂东西、捕鱼等。
example_zh: 一张照片/窗帘/衣钩

definition: used to express what you hope will happen
example: Hopefully, we'll arrive before dark.
definition_zh: 用来表达你希望发生的事情
example_zh: 希望我们能在天黑前到达。

definition: to organize an event to which others are invited and make all the arrangements for them
example: to host an event/a conference/a meeting
definition_zh: 组织一场邀请他人参加的活动，并为他们安排一切事宜
example_zh: 举办活动/会议/会议

definition: to provide a place for a person or an animal to live
example: The government is committed to housing the refugees.
definition_zh: 为人或动物提供居住场所
example_zh: 政府致力于为难民提供安置。

definition: all the people living together in a house or flat
example: Most households now own at least one car.
definition_zh: 所有住在同一栋房子或公寓里的人
example_zh: 现在大多数家庭至少拥有一辆汽车。

definition: houses, flats, etc. that people live in, especially when referring to their type, price or condition
example: rental/student housing
definition_zh: 人们居住的房屋、公寓等，尤其是指其类型、价格或状况时
example_zh: 出租/学生宿舍

definition: funny; showing a sense of humour
example: He gave a humorous account of their trip to Spain.
definition_zh: 幽默;展现幽默感
example_zh: 他幽默地讲述了他们前往西班牙的旅行。

definition: the quality in something that makes it funny; the ability to laugh at things that are funny
example: It was a story full of gentle humour.
definition_zh: 事物本身的品质，使其变得有趣;能够笑出声来对那些好笑的事情
example_zh: 这是一个充满温柔幽默的故事。

definition: the state of not having enough food to eat, especially when this causes illness or death
example: Around fifty people die of hunger every day in the camp.
definition_zh: 食物不足的状态，尤其是当这导致疾病或死亡时
example_zh: 营地里每天约有五十人死于饥饿。

definition: an act of looking for somebody/something that is difficult to find
example: The hunt is on for a suitable candidate.
definition_zh: 寻找某个难以找到的人或物的行为
example_zh: 寻找合适的人选已经开始。

definition: going after and killing wild animals as a sport or for food
example: He goes hunting every weekend.
definition_zh: 作为一项运动或为了食物而追捕并杀死野生动物
example_zh: 他每个周末都去打猎。

definition: a feeling of unhappiness because somebody has been unkind or unfair to you
example: There was hurt and real anger in her voice.
definition_zh: 因为有人对你不友善或不公平而感到不快乐
example_zh: 她的声音里带着伤痛和真正的愤怒。

definition: an idea or explanation of something that is based on a few known facts but that has not yet been proved to be true or correct
example: to formulate/confirm a hypothesis
definition_zh: 基于少数已知事实但尚未被证明为真或正确的想法或解释
example_zh: 以建立/确认假设

definition: a small symbol on a computer or smartphone screen that represents a program or a file
example: Click on the printer icon with the mouse.
definition_zh: 计算机或智能手机屏幕上的一个小符号，代表一个程序或文件
example_zh: 用鼠标点击打印机图标。

definition: an official way of showing who you are, for example a document with your name, date of birth and often a photograph on it (the abbreviation for ‘identity’ or ‘identification’)
example: You must carry ID at all times.
definition_zh: 一种官方展示身份的方式，例如一份写有姓名、出生日期以及通常附有照片的文件（即“身份”或“身份证明”的缩写）
example_zh: 您必须随身携带身份证件。

definition: an idea or standard that seems perfect, and worth trying to achieve or obtain
example: He was accused of betraying his political ideals.
definition_zh: 一个看似完美、值得尝试实现或获得的想法或标准
example_zh: 他被指控背叛了自己的政治理想。

definition: similar in every detail
example: a row of identical houses
definition_zh: 每个细节都相似
example_zh: 一排一模一样的房屋

definition: a false idea or belief, especially about somebody or about a situation
example: under the illusion that…, She's under the illusion that (= believes wrongly that) she'll get the job.
definition_zh: 一个错误的想法或信念，尤其是关于某个人或某个情境的
example_zh: 她抱着一种错觉，认为自己会得到这份工作（=错误地相信）。

definition: to use pictures, photographs, diagrams, etc. in a book, etc.
example: illustrate something, She illustrated her own books.
definition_zh: 在书中使用图片、照片、图表等。
example_zh: 画点什么，她给自己的书画插图。

definition: a drawing or picture in a book, magazine, for decoration or to explain something
example: 50 full-colour illustrations
definition_zh: 书籍、杂志中的绘画或图片，用于装饰或解释某事
example_zh: 50幅全彩插图

definition: the ability to create pictures in your mind; the part of your mind that does this
example: a vivid/fertile imagination
definition_zh: 在脑海中创造画面的能力;你大脑中负责这样做的部分
example_zh: 丰富/丰富的想象力

definition: the process of coming to live permanently in a different country from the one you were born in; the number of people who do this
example: legal/illegal immigration
definition_zh: 在与出生国不同的国家永久定居的过程;这样做的人数量
example_zh: 合法/非法移民

definition: that cannot catch or be affected by a particular disease or illness
example: Adults are often immune to German measles.
definition_zh: 不能感染或受特定疾病影响的
example_zh: 成年人通常对德国麻疹免疫。

definition: annoyed by somebody/something, especially because you have to wait for a long time
example: I'd been waiting for twenty minutes and I was getting impatient.
definition_zh: 被某人或某事惹恼，尤其是因为你得等很久
example_zh: 我已经等了二十分钟，越来越不耐烦了。

definition: to make something that has been officially decided start to happen or be used
example: to implement changes/decisions/policies/reforms
definition_zh: 让已经正式决定的事情开始发生或被使用。
example_zh: 实施变更/决策/政策/改革

definition: a possible effect or result of an action or a decision
example: They failed to consider the wider implications of their actions.
definition_zh: 某项行动或决定可能产生的影响或结果
example_zh: 他们未能考虑自己行为的更广泛影响。

definition: to suggest that something is true or that you feel or think something, without saying so directly
example: imply (that)…, Are you implying (that) I am wrong?
definition_zh: 暗示某件事是真的，或者你有某种感受或想法，但不必直接说出来
example_zh: 暗示（那）......你是在暗示（我错了）吗？

definition: to introduce a new law, rule, tax, etc.; to order that a rule, punishment, etc. be used
example: impose something, The UN Security Council imposed sanctions in 1992.
definition_zh: 引入新的法律、规则、税收等;命令使用某条规则、惩罚等
example_zh: 施加一些措施，联合国安理会在1992年实施了制裁。

definition: if a person or thing impresses you, you admire them or it
example: impress (somebody), We interviewed a number of candidates but none of them impressed us.
definition_zh: 如果一个人或某件事让你印象深刻，你会欣赏他们或它
example_zh: 给（某人）留下深刻印象，我们面试了不少候选人，但没有一个给我们留下深刻印象。

definition: admiring somebody/something because you think they are particularly good, interesting, etc.
example: I must admit I am impressed.
definition_zh: 欣赏某人或某物，因为你觉得他们特别优秀、有趣等等。
example_zh: 我必须承认，我很佩服。

definition: something that encourages you to do something
example: There is no incentive for people to save fuel.
definition_zh: 一些能激励你去做某件事的东西
example_zh: 人们没有动力去节省燃料。

definition: a unit for measuring length or height, equal to 2.54 centimetres. There are 12 inches in a foot.
example: She's a few inches taller than me.
definition_zh: 一个用于测量长度或高度的单位，等于2.54厘米。每英尺有12英寸。
example_zh: 她比我高几英寸。

definition: something that happens, especially something unusual or unpleasant
example: His bad behaviour was just an isolated incident.
definition_zh: 发生的事情，尤其是不寻常或不愉快的事情
example_zh: 他的不良行为只是个孤立事件。

definition: the money that a person, a region, a country, etc. earns from work, from investing money, from business, etc.
example: Average household income fell slightly.
definition_zh: 一个人、一个地区、一个国家等通过工作、投资、商业等获得的钱。
example_zh: 平均家庭收入略有下降。

definition: to include something so that it forms a part of something
example: incorporate something, The new car design incorporates all the latest safety features.
definition_zh: 将某件事纳入其中，使其成为某部分
example_zh: 加入一些东西，新车设计融合了所有最新的安全配置。

definition: not accurate or true
example: incorrect information/spelling
definition_zh: 不准确也不真实
example_zh: 信息/拼写错误

definition: more and more all the time
example: Tourism is playing an increasingly important role in the region's economy
definition_zh: 越来越多，越来越多
example_zh: 旅游业在该地区经济中扮演着越来越重要的角色

definition: freedom from political control by other countries
example: Cuba gained independence from Spain in 1898.
definition_zh: 免受其他国家政治控制的自由
example_zh: 古巴于1898年从西班牙获得独立。

definition: a list of names or topics that are referred to in a book, etc., usually arranged at the end of a book in alphabetical order or listed in a separate file or book
example: Look it up in the index.
definition_zh: 书中提及的名字或主题列表，通常按字母顺序排列在书末，或单独列出文件或书籍
example_zh: 去索引里查一下。

definition: a remark or sign that shows that something is happening or what somebody is thinking or feeling
example: indication of something, They gave no indication of how the work should be done.
definition_zh: 一种提示或迹象，表明某事正在发生，或者某人正在思考或感受什么
example_zh: 只是暗示了什么，却没有说明工作应该如何进行。

definition: connected with industry
example: an industrial dispute
definition_zh: 与工业相关
example_zh: 一场劳资纠纷

definition: that you cannot avoid or prevent
example: It was an inevitable consequence of the decision.
definition_zh: 你无法避免或阻止
example_zh: 这是这一决定不可避免的后果。

definition: as is certain to happen
example: Inevitably, the press exaggerated the story.
definition_zh: 这肯定会发生
example_zh: 媒体不可避免地夸大了这个故事。

definition: the act or process of causing or getting a disease
example: to cause/prevent infection
definition_zh: 导致或感染疾病的行为或过程
example_zh: 以引起/预防感染

definition: to reach an opinion or decide that something is true on the basis of information that is available
example: infer something (from something), Much of the meaning must be inferred from the context.
definition_zh: 根据现有信息达成意见或认定某事为真
example_zh: 从某物推断某物，许多含义必须从上下文中推断。

definition: a general rise in the prices of services and goods in a particular country, resulting in a fall in the value of money; the rate at which this happens
example: the fight against rising inflation
definition_zh: 某一国家服务和商品价格普遍上涨，导致货币价值下降;发生这一现象的速度
example_zh: 抗击不断上升的通货膨胀

definition: information
example: For more info, click here.
definition_zh: 信息
example_zh: 欲了解更多信息，请点击这里。

definition: to tell somebody about something, especially in an official way
example: inform somebody, The government took this decision without consulting Parliament or informing the public.
definition_zh: 告诉别人一些事情，尤其是以正式的方式
example_zh: 通知某人，政府在未征求议会意见、也未告知公众的情况下作出了这一决定。

definition: the basic systems and services that a country or organization needs to function
example: The government is investing in transport infrastructure.
definition_zh: 一个国家或组织运作所需的基本系统和服务
example_zh: 政府正在投资交通基础设施。

definition: a person or an animal that lives in a particular place
example: the oldest inhabitant of the village
definition_zh: 生活在特定地点的人或动物
example_zh: 村里最古老的居民

definition: to receive money, property, etc. from somebody when they die
example: inherit something from somebody, She inherited a fortune from her father.
definition_zh: 在某人去世时，从他们那里获得金钱、财产等
example_zh: 从别人那里继承了什么，她从父亲那里继承了一笔财富。

definition: happening at the beginning; first
example: There is an initial payment of £60 followed by ten instalments of £25.
definition_zh: 发生在开头;首先
example_zh: 首期付款为60英镑，随后分十期支付，每期25英镑。

definition: at the beginning
example: Initially, the system worked well.
definition_zh: 在一开始
example_zh: 起初，系统运作良好。

definition: a new plan for dealing with a particular problem or for achieving a particular purpose
example: a United Nations peace initiative
definition_zh: 为应对特定问题或实现特定目的制定新计划
example_zh: 联合国和平倡议

definition: coloured liquid for writing, drawing and printing
example: in ink, written in ink
definition_zh: 用于书写、绘图和印刷的彩色液体
example_zh: 用墨水写的，用墨水写的

definition: inside; towards or close to the centre of a place
example: an inner courtyard
definition_zh: 内部;靠近或靠近某个地方的中心
example_zh: 内院

definition: the introduction of new things, ideas or ways of doing something
example: an age of technological innovation
definition_zh: 引入新事物、新想法或新做法
example_zh: 技术创新的时代

definition: introducing or using new ideas, ways of doing something, etc.
example: There will be a prize for the most innovative design.
definition_zh: 引入或运用新的想法、做事方式等等。
example_zh: 将设有最具创新设计的奖项。

definition: time, knowledge, ideas, etc. that you put into work, a project, etc. in order to make it succeed; the act of putting something in
example: I'd appreciate your input on this.
definition_zh: 你投入到工作、项目等中的时间、知识、想法等，以使其成功;把某样东西投入其中的行为
example_zh: 我很希望能听听你的看法。

definition: an official process to find out the cause of something or to find out information about something
example: a murder inquiry
definition_zh: 一个官方程序，用于查明某事的成因或获取有关某事的信息
example_zh: 谋杀调查

definition: to put something into something else or between two things
example: insert something (in/into something), Insert coins into the slot and press for a ticket.
definition_zh: 把某样东西放进别的东西里，或者夹在两件事之间
example_zh: 把东西插入某个东西（在某个东西里/某个东西里），把硬币投进投币口，然后按键获取一张票。

definition: an understanding of what something is like
example: There are many valuable insights in her book.
definition_zh: 对某样东西是什么样子的理解
example_zh: 她的书中有许多宝贵的见解。

definition: to demand that something happen or that somebody agree to do something
example: I didn't really want to go but he insisted.
definition_zh: 要求某件事发生，或者有人同意做某件事
example_zh: 我其实并不想去，但他坚持要去。

definition: an officer of middle rank in the police force
example: Inspector Maggie Forbes
definition_zh: 警察部队中级军官
example_zh: 玛吉·福布斯探长

definition: to give somebody the desire, confidence or enthusiasm to do something well
example: inspire somebody, The actors' enthusiasm inspired the kids.
definition_zh: 给某人做事的渴望、信心或热情
example_zh: 激励别人，演员们的热情激励了孩子们。

definition: to fix equipment or furniture into position so that it can be used
example: They're planning to install a new drainage system.
definition_zh: 将设备或家具固定到位以便使用。
example_zh: 他们计划安装新的排水系统。

definition: the act of fixing equipment or furniture in position so that it can be used
example: installation costs
definition_zh: 将设备或家具固定到可以使用的位置的行为
example_zh: 安装费用

definition: a particular example or case of something
example: instance of somebody/something, The report highlights a number of instances of injustice.
definition_zh: 某个具体的例子或案例
example_zh: 报告指出了若干不公的案例。

definition: happening immediately
example: This account gives you instant access to your money.
definition_zh: 立即发生
example_zh: 这个账户让你可以即时访问你的资金。

definition: immediately
example: Her voice is instantly recognizable.
definition_zh: 立即
example_zh: 她的声音一听就听起来很清楚。

definition: an organization that has a particular purpose, especially one that is connected with education or a particular profession; the building used by this organization
example: The report was compiled by Germany's five leading economic research institutes.
definition_zh: 具有特定目的的组织，尤其是与教育或特定职业相关的组织;该组织所使用的建筑物
example_zh: 该报告由德国五家领先的经济研究机构共同编制。

definition: a large important organization that has a particular purpose, for example a university or bank
example: The deal is backed by one of the country's largest financial institutions.
definition_zh: 一个具有特定目的的大型重要组织，例如大学或银行
example_zh: 该交易得到了该国最大金融机构之一的支持。

definition: an arrangement with a company in which you pay them regular amounts of money and they agree to pay the costs, for example, if you die or are ill, or if you lose or damage something
example: health/medical insurance
definition_zh: 与一家公司达成的协议，你向他们支付定期金额，他们同意承担费用，例如你去世、生病，或者丢失或损坏物品时
example_zh: 健康/医疗保险

definition: to combine two or more things so that they work together; to combine with something else in this way
example: integrate into/with something, These programs will integrate with your existing software.
definition_zh: 将两个或多个事物结合起来，使其协同工作;以这种方式与其他事物结合
example_zh: 集成到某个东西里/与某个东西，这些程序会和你现有的软件集成。

definition: connected with or using a person’s ability to think in a logical way and understand things
example: Gifted children typically show great intellectual curiosity and a wide range of interests.
definition_zh: 与或利用一个人以逻辑思维和理解事物的能力相关联
example_zh: 天才儿童通常表现出极强的求知欲和广泛的兴趣。

definition: that you are trying to achieve or reach
example: the intended purpose
definition_zh: 你正试图实现或达到的目标
example_zh: 预期目的

definition: very great; very strong
example: We were all suffering in the intense heat.
definition_zh: 非常棒;非常强大
example_zh: 我们都在酷热中受苦。

definition: to communicate with somebody, especially while you work, play or spend time with them
example: Teachers have a limited amount of time to interact with each child.
definition_zh: 与某人沟通，尤其是在工作、娱乐或与他们共度时光时
example_zh: 老师与每个孩子互动的时间有限。

definition: the act of communicating with somebody, especially while you work, play or spend time with them
example: the interaction between performers and their audience
definition_zh: 与某人沟通的行为，尤其是在工作、娱乐或与他们共度时光时
example_zh: 表演者与观众之间的互动

definition: connected with the inside of something
example: the internal structure of a building
definition_zh: 与某物内部相连
example_zh: 建筑的内部结构

definition: to explain the meaning of something
example: The students were asked to interpret the poem.
definition_zh: 用来解释某件事的意义
example_zh: 学生们被要求去诠释这首诗。

definition: the particular way in which something is understood or explained
example: Her evidence suggests a different interpretation of the events.
definition_zh: 某事被理解或解释的特定方式
example_zh: 她的证词表明对事件有不同的解读。

definition: to say or do something that makes somebody stop what they are saying or doing
example: Sorry to interrupt, but there's someone to see you.
definition_zh: 说或做某件事，让某人停止说话或做的事情
example_zh: 抱歉打扰了，有人找你。

definition: a period of time between two events
example: The interval between major earthquakes might be 200 years.
definition_zh: 两个事件之间的一段时间
example_zh: 两次重大地震之间的间隔可能长达200年。

definition: to enter a country, town, etc. using military force in order to take control of it
example: Troops invaded on August 9th that year.
definition_zh: 进入一个国家、城镇等，动用军事力量控制该国。
example_zh: 当年8月9日，军队入侵。

definition: the act of an army entering another country by force in order to take control of it
example: the German invasion of Poland in 1939
definition_zh: 军队以武力进入另一个国家以夺取控制权的行为
example_zh: 1939年德国入侵波兰

definition: an official examination of the facts about a situation, crime, etc.
example: a criminal/murder/police investigation
definition_zh: 对某一情况、犯罪等事实的官方审查。
example_zh: 刑事/谋杀/警方调查

definition: the act of investing money in something
example: foreign/private investment
definition_zh: 投资某物的行为
example_zh: 外国/私人投资

definition: a person or an organization that invests money in something
example: small investors (= private people)
definition_zh: 一个投资于某物的人或组织
example_zh: 小投资者（= 私人）

definition: to separate somebody/something physically or socially from other people or things
example: isolate somebody/yourself/something, Patients with the disease should be isolated.
definition_zh: 将某人/某物在身体或社会上与其他人或事物隔离开来
example_zh: 隔离某人/你自己/某物，患有该病的患者应被隔离。

definition: far away from any others
example: isolated rural areas
definition_zh: 远离其他任何人
example_zh: 偏远农村地区

definition: to make something known formally
