definition: to limit the size, amount or range of something
example: restrict something to something, Speed is restricted to 30 mph in towns.
definition_zh: 限制某物的大小、数量或范围
example_zh: 限制某物到某物，城镇内限速为30英里每小时。

definition: a rule or law that limits what you can do or what can happen
example: import/speed/travel restrictions
definition_zh: 一条限制你能做什么、什么可能发生什么的规则或法律
example_zh: 进口/速度/旅行限制

definition: the selling of goods to the public, usually through shops
example: The recommended retail price is £9.99.
definition_zh: 向公众销售商品，通常通过商店进行
example_zh: 推荐零售价为9.99英镑。

definition: to keep something; to continue to have something
example: to retain your independence
definition_zh: 为了保留某些东西;为了继续拥有某些东西
example_zh: 保持你的独立性

definition: the fact of leaving your job and stopping work, usually because you have reached a particular age; the time when you do this
example: At 60, he was now approaching retirement.
definition_zh: 比如你离开工作并停止工作，通常是因为你到了某个特定的年龄;你这样做的时间
example_zh: 60岁的他已接近退休。

definition: to make something known to somebody
example: reveal something, to reveal a secret
definition_zh: 让某人知道某件事
example_zh: 揭示些什么，揭露一个秘密

definition: the money that a government receives from taxes or that an organization, etc. receives from its business
example: The government is currently facing a shortfall in tax revenue.
definition_zh: 政府从税收中获得的钱，或一个组织等从其业务中获得的收入
example_zh: 政府目前正面临税收短缺的问题。

definition: a change or set of changes to something
example: He made some minor revisions to the report before printing it out.
definition_zh: 对某件事的变更或一组变更
example_zh: 他在打印报告前对报告做了些小修改。

definition: an attempt, by a large number of people, to change the government of a country, especially by violent action
example: a socialist revolution
definition_zh: 大量人试图通过暴力手段改变一个国家的政府
example_zh: 一场社会主义革命

definition: a thing that you are given because you have done something good, worked hard, etc.
example: a financial reward
definition_zh: 那是因为你做了好事、努力工作等而得到的。
example_zh: 经济奖励

definition: to give something to somebody because they have done something good, worked hard, etc.
example: reward somebody for something, She was rewarded for her efforts with a cash bonus.
definition_zh: 因为某人做了好事、努力工作，所以给他们一些东西。
example_zh: 奖励某人，她因努力得到了现金奖金。

definition: a strong regular repeated pattern of sounds or movements
example: to dance to the rhythm of the music
definition_zh: 强烈、规律、重复的声音或动作模式
example_zh: 随着音乐的节奏起舞

definition: to be free of somebody/something that has been annoying you or that you do not want
example: She wanted to be rid of her parents and their authority.
definition_zh: 摆脱那些一直让你烦恼或你不想要的人/物
example_zh: 她想摆脱父母和他们的权威。

definition: very silly or unreasonable
example: I look ridiculous in this hat.
definition_zh: 非常愚蠢或不讲理
example_zh: 我戴这顶帽子真是太滑稽了。

definition: involving the possibility of something bad happening
example: Life as an aid worker can be a risky business (= dangerous).
definition_zh: 涉及可能发生不好的事
example_zh: 作为援助工作者的生活可能是一项风险极高的行业（= 危险）。

definition: competing with another person, company, thing, etc.
example: a rival bid/claim/offer
definition_zh: 与另一个人、公司、事物竞争等等。
example_zh: 竞争对手的竞标/主张/要约

definition: a person, company or thing that competes with another in sport, business, etc.
example: The two teams have always been rivals.
definition_zh: 一个在体育、商业等领域与其他人竞争的人、公司或事物。
example_zh: 这两支球队一直是对手。

definition: to steal money or property from a person or place
example: to rob a bank
definition_zh: 从某人或某地偷钱或财产
example_zh: 抢银行

definition: the crime of stealing money or goods from a bank, shop, person, etc., especially using violence or threats
example: armed robbery (= using a gun, knife, etc.)
definition_zh: 从银行、商店、个人等处偷钱或货物的犯罪，尤其是使用暴力或威胁的行为
example_zh: 持械抢劫（=使用枪支、刀具等）

definition: a spacecraft in the shape of a tube that is driven by a stream of gases let out behind it when fuel is burned inside
example: a space rocket
definition_zh: 一艘形状如管的航天器，由燃料燃烧后释放的气体流驱动
example_zh: 一枚太空火箭

definition: an exciting, usually short, relationship between two people who are in love with each other
example: a holiday romance
definition_zh: 一段激动人心、通常短暂的恋情，发生在两个相爱的人之间
example_zh: 一段假期浪漫

definition: the part of a plant that grows under the ground and takes in water and minerals that it sends to the rest of the plant
example: deep spreading roots
definition_zh: 植物的那部分生长在地下，吸收水分和矿物质，并将其输送到植物的其他部分
example_zh: 深层蔓延的根系

definition: a flower with a sweet smell that grows on a bush with thorns (= sharp points) on its stems
example: a bunch of red roses
definition_zh: 一种带有甜香的花，生长在茎上带刺（=尖尖）的灌木上
example_zh: 一束红玫瑰

definition: approximately but not exactly
example: Sales are up by roughly 10 per cent.
definition_zh: 大致但不完全
example_zh: 销售额大约增长了10%。

definition: a stage in a competition or sports event
example: the qualifying rounds of the National Championships
definition_zh: 比赛或体育赛事中的一个舞台
example_zh: 全国锦标赛的资格赛轮

definition: done or happening as a normal part of a particular job, situation or process
example: routine enquiries/questions/tests/screening
definition_zh: 作为特定工作、情境或流程的正常组成部分进行或发生
example_zh: 例行询问/问题/测试/筛查

definition: to move your hand, a cloth, etc., backwards and forwards over a surface while pressing it
example: rub something, He sat up on the hard bunk and rubbed his eyes.
definition_zh: 用手、布等在表面上来回移动，同时按压它
example_zh: 揉了揉什么，他坐起身，揉了揉眼睛。

definition: made of rubber
example: a rubber ball
definition_zh: 橡胶制成
example_zh: 一个橡胶球

definition: a strong substance that can be stretched and does not allow liquids to pass through it, used for making tyres, boots, etc. It is made from the liquid (= sap) inside a tropical plant or is produced using chemicals.
example: a ball made of rubber
definition_zh: 一种可以拉伸且不允许液体通过的强硬物质，用于制造轮胎、靴子等。它由热带植物内部的液体（=汁液）制成，或通过化学品制成。
example_zh: 一个橡胶球

definition: the state or process of being destroyed or severely damaged
example: A large number of churches fell into ruin after the revolution.
definition_zh: 被毁坏或严重损坏的状态或过程
example_zh: 革命后，大量教堂沦为废墟。

definition: to damage something so badly that it loses all its value, pleasure, etc.
example: The bad weather ruined our trip.
definition_zh: 把某样东西损坏到失去所有价值、乐趣等。
example_zh: 恶劣的天气毁了我们的旅行。

definition: connected with or like the countryside
example: rural areas
definition_zh: 与乡村相连或类似乡村
example_zh: 农村地区

definition: a sudden strong movement or action
example: rush for something, Shoppers made a rush for the exits.
definition_zh: 突然强烈的动作或动作
example_zh: 抢着东西，购物者则急忙冲向出口。

definition: to move or to do something with great speed, often too fast
example: We've got plenty of time; there's no need to rush.
definition_zh: 以极快的速度移动或做某事，往往速度过快
example_zh: 我们有充足的时间;没必要着急。

definition: to try a small amount of a particular food to see what it is like; to experience something for a short time to see what it is like
example: I sampled the delights of Greek cooking for the first time.
definition_zh: 尝试少量特定食物，感受它是什么感觉;短时间体验某种食物，感受它是什么感觉
example_zh: 我第一次品尝了希腊料理的美味。

definition: an electronic device that is sent into space and moves around the earth or another planet. It is used for communicating by radio, television, etc. and for gathering information.
example: a weather/communications/spy satellite
definition_zh: 一种被送入太空并在地球或其他行星上移动的电子设备。它用于通过无线电、电视等进行通信，并收集信息。
example_zh: 一颗气象/通信/间谍卫星

definition: the good feeling that you have when you have achieved something or when something that you wanted to happen does happen; something that gives you this feeling
example: to gain/get/derive satisfaction from something
definition_zh: 当你完成某件事，或者当你希望发生的事情发生时，你会有那种美好的感觉;那种能带给你这种感觉的事情
example_zh: 从某事中获得/获得/获得满足感

definition: pleased because you have achieved something or because something that you wanted to happen has happened
example: a satisfied customer
definition_zh: 因为你取得了某件事，或者因为你想发生的事情发生了而感到高兴
example_zh: 满意的客户

definition: to make somebody pleased by doing or giving them what they want
example: Nothing satisfies him—he's always complaining.
definition_zh: 通过做或给予某人想要的，让他们感到满意
example_zh: 什么都不能让他满意——他总是在抱怨。

definition: an amount of something such as time or money that you do not need to use or spend
example: saving of something, Buy three and make a saving of 55p.
definition_zh: 一个你不需要使用或花费的金额，比如时间或金钱
example_zh: 省点东西，买三个省下55便士。

definition: the size or extent of something, especially when compared with something else
example: on a … scale, They entertain on a large scale (= they hold expensive parties with a lot of guests).
definition_zh: 某件事的大小或范围，尤其是与另一件事相比时
example_zh: 在......规模上，他们大规模招待宾客（=举办昂贵的派对，宾客众多）。

definition: behaviour or an event that people think is morally or legally wrong and causes public feelings of shock or anger
example: a series of sex scandals
definition_zh: 人们认为在道德或法律上错误的行为或事件，并引发公众震惊或愤怒的情绪
example_zh: 一系列性丑闻

definition: a situation in which a lot of people are anxious or frightened about something
example: a health scare
definition_zh: 很多人对某件事感到焦虑或害怕的情况
example_zh: 一场健康恐慌

definition: to frighten somebody
example: scare somebody, You scared me.
definition_zh: 吓唬别人
example_zh: 吓到别人了，你吓到我了。

definition: a description of how things might happen in the future
example: Let me suggest a possible scenario.
definition_zh: 未来事情可能如何发生的描述
example_zh: 让我提出一个可能的情景。

definition: to arrange for something to happen at a particular time
example: schedule something for something, The meeting is scheduled for Friday afternoon.
definition_zh: 安排某件事在特定时间发生
example_zh: 安排点什么，会议定在周五下午。

definition: a plan or system for doing or organizing something
example: a training scheme
definition_zh: 用于执行或组织某事的计划或系统
example_zh: 培训方案

definition: a person who knows a lot about a particular subject because they have studied it in detail
example: a classical scholar
definition_zh: 指对某一特定学科非常了解的人，因为他们对某一学科进行了详细研究
example_zh: 一位古典学者

definition: an amount of money given to somebody by an organization to help pay for their education
example: She won a scholarship to study at Stanford.
definition_zh: 由某个组织为帮助支付某人教育费用而发放的一笔钱
example_zh: 她获得了斯坦福大学的奖学金。

definition: a mark, a cut or an injury made by scratching somebody’s skin or the surface of something
example: Her hands were covered in scratches from the brambles.
definition_zh: 一个痕迹、割伤或因抓挠某人皮肤或某物表面而留下的伤害
example_zh: 她的手上满是荆棘留下的抓痕。

definition: to rub your skin with your nails, usually because it is itching
example: scratch something, John yawned and scratched his chin.
definition_zh: 用指甲摩擦皮肤，通常是因为皮肤痒
example_zh: 挠了挠什么，约翰打了个哈欠，挠了挠下巴。

definition: a loud high shout made by somebody who is hurt, frightened, excited, etc.; a loud high noise
example: scream of something, She let out a scream of pain.
definition_zh: 受伤、害怕、兴奋等人发出的高声喊叫;高亢的噪音
example_zh: 某种尖叫，她发出一声痛苦的尖叫。

definition: to give a loud, high shout, because you are hurt, frightened, excited, etc.
example: There was a bang and I heard someone scream.
definition_zh: 大声喊叫，因为你受伤、害怕、兴奋等等。
example_zh: 突然传来一声巨响，我听到有人尖叫。

definition: to show a film, etc. in a cinema or on television
example: a list of films to be screened as part of the festival
definition_zh: 在影院或电视上放映电影等
example_zh: 作为电影节一部分放映的影片列表

definition: the act of showing a film or television programme
example: This will be the movie's first screening in this country.
definition_zh: 播放电影或电视节目的行为
example_zh: 这将是该片在美国的首次放映。

definition: to give somebody a place to sit; to sit down in a place
example: Please wait to be seated (= in a restaurant, etc.).
definition_zh: 给别人一个坐下的地方;让别人能在某个地方坐下
example_zh: 请等待入座（=在餐厅等）。

definition: a part of an area of activity, especially of a country’s economy
example: the service/banking/manufacturing/financial sector
definition_zh: 属于某一活动领域，尤其是国家经济的一部分
example_zh: 服务业/银行业/制造业/金融业

definition: likely to continue or be successful for a long time
example: a secure job/income
definition_zh: 有可能长期持续或取得成功
example_zh: 一份稳定的工作/收入

definition: to obtain or achieve something, especially when this means using a lot of effort
example: secure something, to secure a contract/deal/funding
definition_zh: 为了获得或实现某样东西，尤其是当这意味着付出大量努力时
example_zh: 先拿到某样东西，以达成合同/交易/资金

definition: to look for something/somebody
example: seek something/somebody, Drivers are advised to seek alternative routes.
definition_zh: 去寻找某物/某人
example_zh: 寻找某物或某人，建议司机寻找其他路线。

definition: a person who is trying to find or get the thing mentioned
example: an attention/a publicity seeker
definition_zh: 一个试图找到或获得提到的那个东西的人
example_zh: 一个关注/寻求曝光的人

definition: to choose somebody/something from a group of people or things, usually according to a system
example: select somebody/something for something, He hasn't been selected for the team.
definition_zh: 从一群人或一件事中选择某人或某物，通常是按照某种系统
example_zh: 为某件事选一个人/某物，他还没被选进团队。

definition: the process of choosing somebody/something from a group of people or things, usually according to a system
example: She took a long time to make her selection.
definition_zh: 从一群人或事物中选择某人或某物的过程，通常根据某种系统
example_zh: 她花了很长时间才做出选择。

definition: the type of person you are, especially the way you normally behave, look or feel
example: You'll soon be feeling your old self again (= feeling well or happy again).
definition_zh: 你是怎样的人，尤其是你平时的行为、外貌或感受
example_zh: 你很快会重新感受到从前的自己（=感觉良好或再次快乐）。

definition: a class at a university or college when a small group of students and a teacher discuss or study a particular topic
example: Teaching is by lectures and seminars.
definition_zh: 大学或学院的一门课，一小群学生和一位老师讨论或研究某个特定主题
example_zh: 教学通过讲座和研讨会进行。

definition: high in rank or status; higher in rank or status than others
example: a senior official/officer/manager/executive
definition_zh: 地位或地位高;地位或地位高于他人
example_zh: 高级官员/官员/经理/高管

definition: to become aware of something even though you cannot see it, hear it, etc.
example: sense something, Sensing danger, they started to run.
definition_zh: 即便看不见、听不到某样东西，仍然能意识到它。
example_zh: 他们感知到什么，察觉到危险，开始逃跑。

definition: aware of and able to understand other people and their feelings
example: a sensitive and caring man
definition_zh: 能够感知并理解他人及其感受
example_zh: 一个敏感且关怀他人的男人

definition: to say officially in court that somebody is to receive a particular punishment
example: sentence somebody to something, He sentenced the defendant to life in prison.
definition_zh: 在法庭上正式宣布某人将受到特定惩罚
example_zh: 判某人某事，他判被告终身监禁。

definition: a set of events, actions, numbers, etc. which have a particular order and which lead to a particular result
example: He described the sequence of events leading up to the robbery.
definition_zh: 一组具有特定顺序并导致特定结果的事件、动作、数字等
example_zh: 他描述了抢劫发生前的经过。

definition: a period of time that is spent doing a particular activity
example: a training/practice session
definition_zh: 用于某项特定活动的时间段
example_zh: 培训/练习课程

definition: to put an end to an argument or a disagreement
example: settle something, to settle a dispute/a matter/an issue
definition_zh: 结束争论或分歧
example_zh: 解决某件事，解决纠纷/事项/问题

definition: a person who goes to live in a new country or region
example: Most of the settlers came from England.
definition_zh: 一个前往新国家或新地区生活的人
example_zh: 大多数定居者来自英国。

definition: extremely bad or serious
example: His injuries are severe.
definition_zh: 极其严重或严重
example_zh: 他的伤势很严重。

definition: very badly or seriously
example: severely injured
definition_zh: 非常严重或严重
example_zh: 重伤

definition: sexually attractive
example: the sexy lead singer
definition_zh: 性吸引力
example_zh: 性感主唱

definition: an area that is dark and cool under or behind something, for example a tree or building, because the sun’s light does not get to it
example: shade of something, The shade of the pine tree provided some protection from the sun.
definition_zh: 一个阴暗且凉爽的区域，位于某物的下方或后面，比如一棵树或建筑物，因为阳光无法照射到那里
example_zh: 某种阴影，松树的阴影为阳光提供了一定的遮蔽。

definition: the dark shape that somebody/something’s form makes on a surface, for example on the ground, when they are between the light and the surface
example: The children were having fun, chasing each other's shadows.
definition_zh: 某人或某物的形态在表面上形成的暗影，比如在地面上，当他们处于光线和表面之间时
example_zh: 孩子们玩得很开心，追逐彼此的影子。

definition: not having much distance between the top or surface and the bottom
example: a shallow dish/pan/bowl
definition_zh: 顶部或表面与底部之间距离不大
example_zh: 浅盘/锅/碗

definition: used to say that something is a cause for feeling sad or disappointed
example: She's retiring because of ill health, which is a great shame.
definition_zh: 过去常说，某件事是让人感到难过或失望的原因
example_zh: 她因健康不佳要退休，真是太可惜了。

definition: to make something into a particular shape
example: shape A into B, Shape the dough into a ball.
definition_zh: 把某样东西做成某种特定的形状
example_zh: 把A变成B，把面团揉成球。

definition: having the type of shape mentioned
example: a huge balloon shaped like a giant cow
definition_zh: 具有上述形状类型
example_zh: 一个巨大的气球，形状像一头巨型奶牛

definition: the fact of having a place to live or stay, considered as a basic human need
example: Human beings need food, clothing and shelter.
definition_zh: 拥有一个居住或停留的地方，被视为人类的基本需求
example_zh: 人类需要食物、衣物和住所。

definition: to give somebody/something a place where they are protected from the weather or from danger; to protect somebody/something
example: shelter somebody/something from somebody/something, Trees shelter the house from the wind.
definition_zh: 为某人/某物提供一个能免受天气或危险保护的地方;保护某人/某物
example_zh: 为某人/某物遮挡风，树木为房子遮挡风。

definition: to move, or move something, from one position or place to another
example: Lydia shifted uncomfortably in her chair.
definition_zh: 移动，或者把某样东西从一个位置或地点移动到另一个位置
example_zh: 莉迪亚在椅子上不自在地挪了挪。

definition: to send or transport somebody/something by ship or by another means of transport
example: The company ships its goods all over the world.
definition_zh: 通过船舶或其他运输方式将某人/某物送往或运输
example_zh: 公司将货物运往全球各地。

definition: a strong feeling of surprise as a result of something happening, especially something unpleasant; the event that causes this feeling
example: I got a terrible shock the other day.
definition_zh: 因发生某事而产生的强烈惊讶感，尤其是不愉快的事;引发这种感觉的事件
example_zh: 前几天我受到了一次可怕的惊吓。

definition: to surprise and upset somebody
example: shock somebody, President Kennedy's assassination in Dallas on November 22, 1963, shocked the world.
definition_zh: 给某人一个惊喜和难过
example_zh: 令人震惊的是，肯尼迪总统于1963年11月22日在达拉斯遇刺，震惊了全世界。

definition: surprised and upset; showing that somebody feels surprised and upset
example: I was quite shocked when I found out what he'd done.
definition_zh: 惊讶和难过;表现出有人感到惊讶和难过
example_zh: 当我得知他做了什么时，我非常震惊。

definition: that offends or upsets people; that is morally wrong
example: shocking behaviour
definition_zh: 那会冒犯或激怒别人;那是道德错误的
example_zh: 令人震惊的行为

definition: a situation in which a person is shot with a gun
example: Terrorist groups claimed responsibility for the shootings and bomb attacks.
definition_zh: 指有人被枪击的情况
example_zh: 恐怖组织声称对枪击和爆炸袭击负责。

definition: the land along the edge of the sea, the ocean or a lake
example: a rocky/sandy shore
definition_zh: 海边的陆地、海洋或湖泊
example_zh: 岩石/沙质海岸

definition: lasting a short time; designed only for a short period of time in the future
example: a short-term loan
definition_zh: 寿命很短;仅为未来短期设计
example_zh: 短期贷款

definition: a situation when there is not enough of the people or things that are needed
example: food/housing/water shortages
definition_zh: 当所需的人或物不足时，这种情况
example_zh: 食品/住房/水资源短缺

definition: a short time; not long
example: She arrived shortly after us.
definition_zh: 时间很短;不长
example_zh: 她比我们晚了不久就到了。

definition: the act of firing a gun; the sound this makes
example: We heard some shots in the distance.
definition_zh: 开枪的动作;这所发出的声音
example_zh: 我们听到远处传来枪声。

definition: a brother or sister
example: squabbles between siblings
definition_zh: 兄弟或姐妹
example_zh: 兄弟姐妹之间的争吵

definition: your name as you usually write it, for example at the end of a letter
example: Someone had forged her signature on the cheque.
definition_zh: 你通常写的名字，比如在信的结尾
example_zh: 有人伪造了她的签名。

definition: the importance of something, especially when this has an effect on what happens in the future
example: a decision of major political significance
definition_zh: 某件事的重要性，尤其是当它影响到未来会发生什么时
example_zh: 一项具有重大政治意义的决定

definition: large or important enough to have an effect or to be noticed
example: There are no significant differences between the two groups of students.
definition_zh: 足够大或足够重要，以至于产生影响或被注意到
example_zh: 两组学生之间没有显著差异。

definition: in a way that is large or important enough to have an effect on something or to be noticed
example: significantly higher/lower/larger/smaller
definition_zh: 以足够重大或足够重要的方式，以至于对某件事产生影响或被注意到
example_zh: 显著高/低/大/小

definition: a complete lack of noise or sound
example: Their footsteps echoed in the silence.
definition_zh: 完全没有噪音或声音
example_zh: 他们的脚步声在寂静中回响。

definition: fine soft thread produced by silkworms
example: The caterpillar spins the silk around its entire body.
definition_zh: 蚕生产的细软丝
example_zh: 毛毛虫将丝线绕着全身旋转。

definition: showing what you really think or feel
example: a sincere apology
definition_zh: 展现你真正的想法或感受
example_zh: 真诚的道歉

definition: having enough ability, experience and knowledge to be able to do something well
example: a skilled engineer/negotiator/craftsman
definition_zh: 拥有足够的能力、经验和知识，才能把某件事做好
example_zh: 一位熟练的工程师/谈判专家/工匠

definition: the bone structure that forms the head and surrounds and protects the brain
example: a fractured skull
definition_zh: 构成头部并包围并保护大脑的骨骼结构
example_zh: 头骨骨折

definition: a person who is owned by another person and is forced to work for and obey them
example: A former slave, he graduated from Clafflin University in South Carolina.
definition_zh: 一个被另一个人拥有、被迫为他人工作和服从的人
example_zh: 他曾是奴隶，毕业于南卡罗来纳州的克拉夫林大学。

definition: one page of an electronic presentation, that may contain text and images, that is usually viewed on a computer screen or projected onto a larger screen
example: Here's a slide showing target markets.
definition_zh: 电子演示文稿的一页，可能包含文本和图像，通常在电脑屏幕上查看或投影到更大的屏幕上
example_zh: 这里有一张展示目标市场的幻灯片。

definition: to move easily over a smooth or wet surface; to make something move in this way
example: As I turned left on a bend, my car started to slide.
definition_zh: 能够在光滑或潮湿的表面上轻松移动;让物体以这种方式移动
example_zh: 当我在一个弯道左转时，车子开始打滑。

definition: very small in degree
example: a slight increase/change/difference
definition_zh: 程度非常小
example_zh: 略有增加/变化/差异

definition: to slide a short distance by accident so that you fall or nearly fall
example: She slipped and landed flat on her back.
definition_zh: 不小心滑了一小段距离，导致你跌倒或差点摔倒
example_zh: 她滑倒，仰面朝下摔倒。

definition: a word or phrase that is easy to remember, used for example by a political party or in advertising to attract people’s attention or to suggest an idea quickly
example: an advertising slogan
definition_zh: 一个容易记忆的词语或短语，例如由政党或广告中使用，用来吸引人们的注意力或快速提出一个想法
example_zh: 广告口号

definition: a surface or piece of land that slopes (= is higher at one end than the other)
example: on a slope, The town is built on a slope.
definition_zh: 一个倾斜的表面或土地（= 一端比另一端高）
example_zh: 城镇建在坡上。

definition: to be at an angle so that it is higher at one end than the other
example: a sloping roof
definition_zh: 使其倾斜，使一端比另一端高
example_zh: 倾斜的屋顶

definition: used to show that you do not think that the word or phrase that is being used to describe somebody/something is appropriate
example: the opinion of a so-called ‘expert’
definition_zh: 用于表示你认为用来描述某人或某事的词语或短语并不恰当
example_zh: 所谓“专家”的意见

definition: of or connected with the sun
example: solar radiation
definition_zh: 与太阳有关或与太阳相连
example_zh: 太阳辐射

definition: in a way that is not known or certain
example: We must stop him from seeing her somehow.
definition_zh: 以一种未知或不确定的方式
example_zh: 我们必须想办法阻止他见她。

definition: at a time that you do not know exactly or has not yet been decided
example: I saw him sometime last summer.
definition_zh: 在你还不确切知道或尚未决定的时间点
example_zh: 我去年夏天见过他。

definition: to some degree
example: somewhat different/similar
definition_zh: 在某种程度上
example_zh: 有些不同/相似

definition: clever and complicated in the way that it works or is presented
example: highly sophisticated computer systems
definition_zh: 无论是在运作方式还是呈现方式上，都既巧妙又复杂
example_zh: 高度复杂的计算机系统

definition: the spiritual part of a person, believed to exist after death
example: He believed his immortal soul was in peril.
definition_zh: 一个人的灵性部分，被认为死后仍然存在
example_zh: 他相信自己不朽的灵魂正处于危险之中。

definition: available to do what you want with rather than work
example: He's studying music in his spare time.
definition_zh: 随时可以随心所欲地使用，而不是工作
example_zh: 他业余时间学习音乐。

definition: having or involving expert knowledge of a particular area of work, study or medicine
example: specialist knowledge/training/skills
definition_zh: 拥有或涉及某一特定工作、学习或医学领域的专业知识
example_zh: 专业知识/培训/技能

definition: a person who is an expert in a particular area of work or study
example: specialist in something, a specialist in Japanese history
definition_zh: 一位在某一特定工作或学习领域具有专家的人
example_zh: 某方面的专家，日本历史专家

definition: to become an expert in a particular area of work, study or business; to spend more time on one area of work, etc. than on others
example: Many students prefer not to specialize too soon.
definition_zh: 成为某一特定工作、学习或商业领域的专家;在某一工作领域等方面投入比其他领域更多的时间
example_zh: 许多学生不愿意过早专攻。

definition: a group into which animals, plants, etc. that are able to have sex with each other and produce healthy young are divided, smaller than a genus and identified by a Latin name
example: a conservation area for endangered species
definition_zh: 这是一个将能够彼此交配并产生健康后代的动植物等划分为一个群体，小于属，并以拉丁名称标识
example_zh: 濒危物种保护区

definition: to state something, especially by giving an exact measurement, time, exact instructions, etc.
example: specify something, Remember to specify your size when ordering clothes.
definition_zh: 要说明一些事情，尤其是给出准确的测量、时间、具体的指示等等。
example_zh: 指定点什么，记得订衣服时要说明你的尺码。

definition: very impressive
example: The coastal road has spectacular scenery.
definition_zh: 非常令人印象深刻
example_zh: 沿海公路风景壮观。

definition: a person who is watching an event, especially a sports event
example: The new football stadium will hold 75 000 spectators.
definition_zh: 一个正在观看某项活动，尤其是体育赛事的人
example_zh: 新足球场将容纳75,000名观众。

definition: to form an opinion about something without knowing all the details or facts
example: speculate (about/on/as to something), We all speculated about the reasons for her resignation.
definition_zh: 在不了解所有细节或事实的情况下，对某件事形成看法
example_zh: 猜测（关于/猜测/关于某件事），我们都猜测她辞职的原因。

definition: the act of forming opinions about what has happened or what might happen without knowing all the facts
example: His private life is the subject of much speculation.
definition_zh: 在不了解所有事实的情况下，对已经发生或可能发生的事情形成看法的行为
example_zh: 他的私生活备受猜测。

definition: to move along quickly
example: They sped off to get help.
definition_zh: 快速推进
example_zh: 他们赶紧开车去寻求帮助。

definition: one of the various types of powder or seed that come from plants and are used in cooking. Spices have a strong taste and smell.
example: common spices such as ginger and cinnamon
definition_zh: 是植物中提取的各种粉末或种子之一，用于烹饪。香料味道和气味都很浓烈。
example_zh: 常见香料，如姜和肉桂

definition: to flow over the edge of a container by accident; to make liquid do this
example: Water had spilled out of the bucket onto the floor.
definition_zh: 意外地流过容器边缘;让液体做到这一点
example_zh: 水从桶里溢出来，洒到了地板上。

definition: connected with the human spirit, rather than the body or physical things
example: a spiritual experience
definition_zh: 与人类精神相连，而非身体或物质
example_zh: 一次精神体验

definition: a feeling of wanting to hurt or upset somebody
example: out of spite, I'm sure he only said it out of spite.
definition_zh: 一种想要伤害或惹恼某人的感觉
example_zh: 我敢肯定他只是出于怨气才这么说的。

definition: an argument or disagreement that divides a group of people or makes somebody separate from somebody else
example: Ten years after their acrimonious split, the band has reformed.
definition_zh: 一种争论或分歧，导致一群人分裂，或使某人与他人分离
example_zh: 在他们激烈分手十年后，乐队重新组建了。

definition: to divide, or to make something divide, into two or more parts
example: split something, He was a member of the team that split the atom in 1932.
definition_zh: 将某物分割，或使之分裂成两个或更多部分
example_zh: 分裂了什么，他是1932年分裂原子团队的成员之一。

definition: to change something good into something bad, unpleasant, etc.
example: Our camping trip was spoilt by bad weather.
definition_zh: 把好事变成坏事、不愉快等等。
example_zh: 我们的露营之旅被恶劣天气毁了。

definition: a person who speaks for a group or an organization
example: a police spokesman
definition_zh: 代表某个团体或组织发言的人
example_zh: 一名警方发言人

definition: a person who speaks for a group or an organization
example: a council spokesperson
definition_zh: 代表某个团体或组织发言的人
example_zh: 一位议会发言人

definition: a woman who speaks for a group or an organization
example: a government spokeswoman
definition_zh: 一位代表某个团体或组织发声的女性
example_zh: 一位政府发言人

definition: a person or company that pays for a radio or television programme, or for a concert or sporting event, usually in return for advertising
example: The programme is funded by a number of corporate sponsors.
definition_zh: 为广播或电视节目、音乐会或体育赛事付费的个人或公司，通常以广告为代价
example_zh: 该项目由多家企业赞助商资助。

definition: to pay the costs of a particular event, programme, etc. as a way of advertising
example: Sports events are no longer sponsored by the tobacco industry.
definition_zh: 以广告方式支付特定活动、节目等的费用
example_zh: 体育赛事不再由烟草行业赞助。

definition: financial support from a sponsor
example: a $50 million sponsorship deal
definition_zh: 赞助商的经济支持
example_zh: 一份价值五千万美元的赞助协议

definition: connected with sports
example: a major sporting event
definition_zh: 与体育相关
example_zh: 一项重大体育赛事

definition: to see or notice a person or thing, especially suddenly or when it is not easy to do so
example: spot somebody/something, Can you spot the difference between these two pictures?
definition_zh: 看到或注意到一个人或某物，尤其是在突然或不容易时
example_zh: 找到某个人/某物，你能分辨这两张照片的区别吗？

definition: an increase in the amount or number of something that there is, or in the area that is affected by something
example: measures to halt the spread of the disease
definition_zh: 某物的数量或数量增加，或受影响区域的数量增加
example_zh: 遏制疾病传播的措施

definition: to move suddenly and with one quick movement in a particular direction
example: The cat crouched ready to spring.
definition_zh: 突然且迅速地朝特定方向移动
example_zh: 猫蹲下，准备跳跃。

definition: fixed or steady; not likely to move, change or fail
example: The patient's condition is stable (= it is not getting worse).
definition_zh: 固定或稳定;不太可能移动、改变或失效
example_zh: 患者的病情稳定（=没有恶化）。

definition: to organize and present a play or an event for people to see
example: to stage a play/an event/an exhibition
definition_zh: 组织并呈现一场戏剧或活动，供公众观看
example_zh: 上演一场戏剧/一场活动/一场展览

definition: a table or small shop with an open front that people sell things from, especially at a market
example: He works on a market stall in the Square.
definition_zh: 一张桌子或小店，前面敞开，人们从那里卖东西，尤其是在市场里
example_zh: 他在广场上的一个市场摊位工作。

definition: the opinions that somebody has about something and expresses publicly
example: What is the newspaper's stance on the war?
definition_zh: 某人对某件事持有并公开表达的看法
example_zh: 报纸对这场战争的立场是什么？

definition: an attitude towards something or an opinion that you make clear to people
example: He has avoided taking a firm stand.
definition_zh: 你对某件事的态度或观点，向别人明确表达
example_zh: 他一直避免采取坚定立场。

definition: to look at somebody/something for a long time
example: I screamed and everyone stared.
definition_zh: 长时间凝视某人/某物
example_zh: 我尖叫了，所有人都盯着看。

definition: to suffer or die because you do not have enough food to eat; to make somebody suffer or die in this way
example: The animals were left to starve to death.
definition_zh: 因为没有足够的食物而受苦或死亡;以这种方式让别人受苦或死亡
example_zh: 这些动物被遗弃，任其饿死。

definition: the legal position of a person, group or country
example: They were granted refugee status.
definition_zh: 个人、团体或国家的法律地位
example_zh: 他们获得了难民身份。

definition: gradually and in an even and regular way
example: The company's exports have been increasing steadily.
definition_zh: 渐进且均匀、规律地进行
example_zh: 公司的出口量一直在稳步增长。

definition: developing, growing, etc. gradually and in an even and regular way
example: We've had five years of steady economic growth.
definition_zh: 发展、成长等，逐步且均匀规律地进行
example_zh: 我们已经经历了五年稳定的经济增长。

definition: the hot gas that water changes into when it boils
example: Steam rose from the boiling kettle.
definition_zh: 水沸腾时变成的热气体
example_zh: 沸腾的水壶冒出蒸汽。

definition: a strong, hard metal that is made of a mixture of iron and carbon
example: the iron and steel industry
definition_zh: 一种坚硬、坚硬的金属，由铁和碳的混合物制成
example_zh: 钢铁工业

definition: rising or falling quickly, not gradually
example: a steep hill/slope
definition_zh: 快速上升或下降，而非渐进式
example_zh: 陡峭的山坡

definition: to lift your foot and move it in a particular direction or put it on or in something; to move a short distance
example: to step onto/off a bus
definition_zh: 抬起你的脚并朝某个特定方向移动，或者把脚放在某个地方或某处;移动一小段距离
example_zh: 上/下公交车

definition: made of or covered in a substance that sticks to things that touch it
example: sticky fingers covered in jam
definition_zh: 由某种物质制成或覆盖，能附着于接触物体
example_zh: 黏糊糊的手指沾满果酱

definition: difficult to bend or move
example: a sheet of stiff black cardboard
definition_zh: 难以弯曲或移动
example_zh: 一张硬挺的黑色纸板

definition: to make something develop or become more active; to encourage something
example: The exhibition has stimulated interest in her work.
definition_zh: 让某件事发展或变得更活跃;鼓励某事
example_zh: 这次展览激发了人们对她作品的兴趣。

definition: a supply of goods that is available for sale in a shop
example: We have a fast turnover of stock.
definition_zh: 商店中可供销售的商品供应
example_zh: 我们的库存周转非常快。

definition: a small, narrow river
example: a mountain stream
definition_zh: 一条狭窄的小河
example_zh: 一条山间小溪

definition: to become more powerful or effective; to make somebody/something more powerful or effective
example: Her position in the party has strengthened in recent weeks.
definition_zh: 变得更有力量或更有效率;让某人/某物变得更强大或更有效率
example_zh: 近几周来，她在党内的地位有所加强。

definition: an area of land or water, especially a long one
example: a particularly dangerous stretch of road
definition_zh: 一片陆地或水域，尤其是长的那种
example_zh: 一段特别危险的路段

definition: to make something longer, wider or looser, for example by pulling it; to become longer, etc. in this way
example: Is there any way of stretching shoes?
definition_zh: 比如通过拉扯使某样东西变长、更宽或更松;以这种方式变长等等
example_zh: 有没有什么办法能给鞋子做拉伸？

definition: that must be obeyed exactly
example: strict rules/regulations
definition_zh: 必须严格遵守
example_zh: 严格的规则/法规

definition: with a lot of control and rules that must be obeyed
example: She was brought up very strictly.
definition_zh: 有大量控制和必须遵守的规则
example_zh: 她从小被严格地养大。

definition: a period of time when an organized group of employees of a company stops working because of an argument over pay or conditions
example: the miners'/firefighters'/teachers' strike
definition_zh: 指公司内部一个有组织的员工群体因薪酬或工作条件争执而停止工作的时间
example_zh: 矿工/消防员/教师罢工

definition: to hit somebody/something hard or with force
example: strike somebody/something, The ship struck a rock.
definition_zh: 用力或用力击打某人或某物
example_zh: 撞到某人/某物，船撞上了岩石。

definition: an act of hitting a ball, for example with a bat or racket
example: What a beautiful stroke!
definition_zh: 例如用球棒或球拍击球的行为
example_zh: 多么美丽的笔触！

definition: to arrange or organize something into a system or pattern
example: structure something, How well does the teacher structure the lessons?
definition_zh: 将某件事组织成系统或模式
example_zh: 想办法安排点什么，老师安排课程的结构得如何？

definition: a hard fight in which people try to obtain or achieve something, especially something that somebody else does not want them to have
example: Marx wrote about the class struggle.
definition_zh: 一场艰难的斗争，人们试图获得或实现某些东西，尤其是别人不希望他们拥有的东西
example_zh: 马克思写过关于阶级斗争的文章。

definition: to try very hard to do something when it is difficult or when there are a lot of problems
example: life as a struggling artist (= one who is very poor)
definition_zh: 在困难或问题重重时，努力去做某件事
example_zh: 作为一个挣扎中的艺术家的生活（=一个非常贫穷的人）

definition: to fill a space or container tightly with something
example: stuff A with B, She had 500 envelopes to stuff with leaflets.
definition_zh: 用某物紧密填满空间或容器
example_zh: A和B一起装东西，她有500个信封要装传单。

definition: extremely attractive or impressive
example: You look absolutely stunning!
definition_zh: 极具吸引力或令人印象深刻
example_zh: 你看起来绝对美极了！

definition: likely to be affected by something, especially something bad
example: At this stage these are proposals and are still subject to change.
definition_zh: 很可能受到某些影响，尤其是坏事
example_zh: 目前这些都是提案，仍可能变更。

definition: to give a document, proposal, etc. to somebody in authority so that they can study or consider it
example: submit something, to submit an application/a claim/a proposal
definition_zh: 将文件、提案等交给有权威的人，让他们研究或考虑
example_zh: 提交一些东西，提交申请/索赔/提案

definition: happening or coming after something else
example: subsequent generations
definition_zh: 发生或紧随其他事而来
example_zh: 后续世代

definition: afterwards; later; after something else has happened
example: The original interview notes were subsequently lost.
definition_zh: 之后;之后;在发生了别的事情之后
example_zh: 最初的采访笔记后来遗失。

definition: an area where people live that is outside the centre of a city
example: a suburb of London
definition_zh: 人们居住、位于城市中心之外的区域
example_zh: 伦敦的一个郊区

definition: physical or mental pain
example: Death finally brought an end to her suffering.
definition_zh: 身体或心理疼痛
example_zh: 死亡终于结束了她的痛苦。

definition: enough for a particular purpose; as much as you need
example: Allow sufficient time to get there.
definition_zh: 足以满足特定目的；达到所需的数量
example_zh: 预留足够的时间到达那里。

definition: enough for a particular purpose; as much as you need
example: The following day she felt sufficiently well to go to work.
definition_zh: 足以满足特定目的；达到所需的数量
example_zh: 第二天，她感觉身体已经足够好，可以去上班。

definition: an amount of money
example: You will be fined the sum of £200.
definition_zh: 一笔钱
example_zh: 你将被罚款200英镑。

definition: to describe or express the main points of something in a short way
example: She summed up the main points of the discussion.
definition_zh: 用简短的方式描述或表达某件事的主要观点
example_zh: 她总结了讨论的主要观点。

definition: extremely good
example: a super meal
definition_zh: 极好
example_zh: 一顿超级大餐

definition: a doctor who is trained to perform surgery (= medical operations that involve cutting open a person’s body)
example: a brain/heart surgeon
definition_zh: 一位受过手术训练的医生（=涉及剖开人体的医疗手术）
example_zh: 脑/心脏外科医生

definition: medical treatment of injuries or diseases that involves cutting open a person’s body and often removing or replacing some parts; the branch of medicine connected with this treatment
example: major/minor surgery
definition_zh: 涉及剖开身体并常常移除或更换部分部位的伤害或疾病的医疗治疗;与此治疗相关的医学分支
example_zh: 大手术/小手术

definition: to be all around something/somebody
example: surround something/somebody, Tall trees surround the lake.
definition_zh: 能够无处不在地围绕着某事或某个人
example_zh: 包围某个东西/某个人，高大的树木环绕着湖面。

definition: that is near or around something
example: Oxford and the surrounding area
definition_zh: 它靠近或环绕着某物
example_zh: 牛津及周边地区

definition: to look carefully at the whole of something, especially in order to get a general impression of it
example: The next morning we surveyed the damage caused by the fire.
definition_zh: 仔细地看一件事的整体，尤其是为了获得它的整体印象
example_zh: 第二天早上，我们对火灾造成的损失进行了勘察。

definition: the state of continuing to live or exist, often despite difficulty or danger
example: the struggle/battle/fight for survival
definition_zh: 即是在困难或危险中继续生活或存在的状态
example_zh: 生存的挣扎/战斗/战斗

definition: a person who continues to live, especially despite being nearly killed or experiencing great danger or difficulty
example: the sole/only survivor of the massacre
definition_zh: 一个即使濒临死亡或经历巨大危险或困难，仍然活下去的人
example_zh: 屠杀中唯一/唯一幸存者

definition: a person who is suspected of a crime or of having done something wrong
example: a murder suspect
definition_zh: 被怀疑犯罪或做了不当事的人
example_zh: 一名谋杀嫌疑人

definition: to have an idea that something is probably true or likely to happen, especially something bad, but without having definite proof
example: As I had suspected all along, he was not a real policeman.
definition_zh: 有一种想法，觉得某件事很可能是真的，或者很可能会发生，尤其是坏事，但没有确凿证据
example_zh: 正如我一直怀疑的那样，他根本不是真正的警察。

definition: to hang something from something else
example: be suspended from something, A lamp was suspended from the ceiling.
definition_zh: 把东西挂在别的东西上
example_zh: 一盏灯悬挂在天花板上。

definition: involving the use of natural products and energy in a way that does not harm the environment
example: sustainable forest management
definition_zh: 以不损害环境的方式使用天然产品和能源
example_zh: 可持续森林管理

definition: to make food, drink, etc. go down your throat into your stomach
example: swallow (something), Always chew food well before swallowing it.
definition_zh: 做食物、饮料等，顺着喉咙进胃里
example_zh: 吞下（某样东西），食物一定要在吞下前仔细咀嚼。

definition: to use rude or offensive language, usually because you are angry
example: She fell over and swore loudly.
definition_zh: 使用粗鲁或冒犯性的语言，通常是因为你生气了
example_zh: 她摔倒了，大声咒骂。

definition: to clean a room, surface, etc. using a broom (= a type of brush on a long handle)
example: sweep (something), to sweep the floor
definition_zh: 用扫帚清洁房间、表面等（=一种长柄刷子）
example_zh: 扫地（某物），扫地

definition: a small device that you press or move up and down in order to turn a light or piece of electrical equipment on and off
example: a light switch
definition_zh: 一个小装置，你用来上下按压或移动，用来开关灯或电气设备
example_zh: 一个灯开关

definition: kind to somebody who is hurt or sad; showing that you understand and care about their problems
example: a sympathetic listener
definition_zh: 对受伤或难过的人表现出善意;表明你理解并关心他们的问题
example_zh: 一位富有同情心的倾听者

definition: the feeling of being sorry for somebody; showing that you understand and care about somebody’s problems
example: sympathy for somebody, to express/feel sympathy for somebody
definition_zh: 为某人感到难过的感觉;表现出你理解并关心某人的困境
example_zh: 对某人表达同情，表达或感受同情

definition: to make a determined effort to deal with a difficult problem or situation
example: The government is determined to tackle inflation.
definition_zh: 为应对困难问题或情况作出坚定努力
example_zh: 政府决心应对通胀。

definition: a small piece of paper, cloth, plastic, etc. attached to something to identify it or give information about it
example: He put name tags on all his shirts.
definition_zh: 一小块纸、布、塑料等附在某物上，用来识别或提供相关信息
example_zh: 他把所有衬衫都贴上了名牌。

definition: to fasten a tag onto something/somebody
example: Each animal was tagged with a number for identification.
definition_zh: 将标签固定在某物/某人上
example_zh: 每只动物都被贴上了编号以便识别。

definition: a story created using the imagination, especially one that is full of action and adventure
example: a coming-of-age/morality tale
definition_zh: 一个用想象力创造的故事，尤其是充满动作和冒险的故事
example_zh: 一个成长/道德故事

definition: a large container for holding liquid or gas
example: a fuel/water/storage tank
definition_zh: 一个用于盛装液体或气体的大容器
example_zh: 燃料/水/储罐

definition: a device for controlling the flow of water from a pipe into a bath or sink
example: bath taps
definition_zh: 一种用于控制水从管道流入浴缸或水槽的装置
example_zh: 浴缸水龙头

definition: to hit somebody/something quickly and lightly
example: tap (away) (at something), Someone tapped at the door.
definition_zh: 快速且轻轻地击打某人或某物
example_zh: 敲门（远离）（某物），有人敲门。

definition: to aim an attack or a criticism at somebody/something
example: target somebody/something, He accused the group of deliberately targeting civilians.
definition_zh: 针对某人或某物发起攻击或批评
example_zh: 他指责该组织故意针对平民。

definition: a hole that has been made in something by tearing
example: This sheet has a tear in it.
definition_zh: 一个通过撕裂在某物上打出的洞
example_zh: 这张床单有个破洞。

definition: to damage something by pulling it apart or into pieces or by cutting it on something sharp; to become damaged in this way
example: tear something + adv./prep., I tore my jeans on the fence.
definition_zh: 通过将某物撕裂、撕成碎片或用尖锐物割伤它;以这种方式受损;
example_zh: 撕破点东西 + 进度/准备，我把牛仔裤在围栏上撕破了。

definition: connected with technology
example: technological advances
definition_zh: 与技术相连
example_zh: 技术进步

definition: the years of a person’s life when they are between 13 and 19 years old
example: in your teens, She began writing poetry in her teens.
definition_zh: 一个人在13到19岁之间的人生年数
example_zh: 在你十几岁的时候，她在十几岁时开始写诗。

definition: a building used for religious worship, especially in religions other than Christianity
example: the Temple of Diana at Ephesus
definition_zh: 一栋用于宗教礼拜的建筑，尤其是在基督教以外的宗教中
example_zh: 以弗所的戴安娜神庙

definition: in a way that lasts or is intended to last or be used only for a short time; in a way that is not permanent
example: We regret this service is temporarily unavailable.
definition_zh: 以一种能够持久、意图持续或仅短期使用的方式;以一种并非永久的方式
example_zh: 很遗憾，这项服务目前暂时无法使用。

definition: lasting or intended to last or be used only for a short time; not permanent
example: to hire temporary workers
definition_zh: 使用寿命或仅短期使用;非永久性
example_zh: 雇佣临时工

definition: if somebody/something has a particular tendency, they are likely to behave or act in a particular way
example: to display artistic tendencies
definition_zh: 如果某人或某物有某种特定倾向，他们很可能会以某种方式行事或行为
example_zh: 以展现艺术倾向

definition: a situation in which people do not trust each other, or feel unfriendly towards each other, and that may cause them to attack each other
example: There is mounting tension along the border.
definition_zh: 一种情形：人们彼此不信任，或者对彼此感到不友好，这可能导致他们互相攻击
example_zh: 边境紧张局势日益加剧。

definition: to use a particular name or word to describe somebody/something
example: term somebody/something + adj., At his age, he can hardly be termed young.
definition_zh: 使用某个特定的名字或词语来描述某人或某物
example_zh: 用某某/某某+形容词称呼他，以他的年纪，很难称得上年轻。

definition: a building or set of buildings at an airport where passengers arrive and leave
example: A second terminal was opened last year.
definition_zh: 机场内旅客抵达和离开的建筑物或建筑群
example_zh: 去年又开设了第二个航站楼。

definition: the conditions that people offer, demand or accept when they make an agreement, an arrangement or a contract
example: peace terms
definition_zh: 人们在达成协议、安排或合同时所提供、要求或接受的条件
example_zh: 和平条款

definition: very
example: I'm terribly sorry—did I hurt you?
definition_zh: 非常
example_zh: 我非常抱歉——我伤害你了吗？

definition: to make somebody feel extremely frightened
example: terrify somebody, Flying terrifies her.
definition_zh: 让某人感到极度恐惧
example_zh: 吓唬别人，飞翔让她害怕。

definition: land that is under the control of a particular country or political leader
example: enemy/disputed/foreign territory
definition_zh: 受特定国家或政治领导人控制的土地
example_zh: 敌对/争议/外国领土

definition: a feeling of extreme fear
example: a feeling of sheer/pure terror
definition_zh: 极度恐惧的感觉
example_zh: 一种纯粹的恐惧感

definition: the use of violent action in order to achieve political aims or to force a government to act
example: an act of terrorism
definition_zh: 为实现政治目标或迫使政府采取行动而使用暴力行动
example_zh: 一起恐怖主义行为

definition: a person who takes part in terrorism
example: The terrorists are threatening to blow up the plane.
definition_zh: 参与恐怖主义的人
example_zh: 恐怖分子威胁要炸毁飞机。

definition: the activity of testing somebody/something in order to find something out, see if it works, etc.
example: nuclear testing
definition_zh: 就是测试某个人或某物以发现问题、看看是否有效等的活动。
example_zh: 核试验

definition: a book that teaches a particular subject and that is used especially in schools and colleges
example: a school/medical/history textbook
definition_zh: 一本教授特定学科的书，尤其在学校和大学中使用
example_zh: 学校/医学/历史教材

definition: the crime of stealing something from a person or place
example: car theft
definition_zh: 从某人或某地偷窃某物的犯罪
example_zh: 汽车盗窃

definition: a specialist who treats a particular type of illness or problem, or who uses a particular type of treatment
example: a speech therapist
definition_zh: 一位治疗特定类型疾病或问题的专家，或使用特定治疗方式的专家
example_zh: 一名言语治疗师

definition: the treatment of a physical problem or an illness
example: He is receiving therapy for cancer.
definition_zh: 治疗身体问题或疾病
example_zh: 他正在接受癌症治疗。

definition: a long piece of writing completed by a student as part of a university degree, based on their own research
example: Students must submit a thesis on an agreed subject within four years.
definition_zh: 学生基于自身研究完成的一篇长篇文章，作为大学学位的一部分
example_zh: 学生必须在四年内提交关于约定主题的论文。

definition: done completely; with great attention to detail
example: a thorough knowledge of the subject
definition_zh: 完全完成;对细节极为讲究
example_zh: 对该领域的深入了解

definition: very much; completely
example: We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves.
definition_zh: 非常；完全
example_zh: 我们玩得非常开心。

definition: a statement in which you tell somebody that you will punish or harm them, especially if they do not do what you want
example: threat against somebody/something, to make threats against somebody
definition_zh: 一种声明，你告诉某人你会惩罚或伤害他们，尤其是如果他们不按你想要的做
example_zh: 对某人/某物的威胁，对某人发出威胁

definition: to say that you will cause trouble, hurt somebody, etc. if you do not get what you want
example: threaten somebody/something, They broke my windows and threatened me.
definition_zh: 说如果得不到你想要的，你会惹麻烦、伤害别人等等
example_zh: 威胁某人/某物，他们砸碎了我的窗户，还威胁我。

definition: the short, thick finger at the side of the hand, slightly apart from the other four
example: She still sucks her thumb when she's worried.
definition_zh: 手侧那根短而粗的手指，与另外四根略有距离
example_zh: 她担心的时候还会吮拇指。

definition: in this way; like this
example: Many scholars have argued thus.
definition_zh: 就这样;像这样
example_zh: 许多学者曾这样论证。

definition: to measure how long it takes for something to happen or for somebody to do something
example: time something, ‘How long does it take to get to Leeds from here?’ ‘I don’t know, I’ve never timed it.’
definition_zh: 用来测量某件事发生或某人做某事需要多长时间
example_zh: 计时，'从这里到利兹要多久？''我不知道，我从没计过时间。'

definition: the act of choosing when something happens; a particular point or period of time when something happens or is planned
example: The timing of the decision was a complete surprise.
definition_zh: 选择某事何时发生的行为;某事发生或计划中的某个特定时间点或时间
example_zh: 这一决定的时机完全出乎意料。

definition: a piece of soft paper, used especially as a handkerchief
example: a box of tissues
definition_zh: 一张软纸，特别用作手帕
example_zh: 一盒纸巾

definition: to give a book, piece of music, etc. a particular name
example: be titled…, Their first album was titled ‘Made in Valmez’.
definition_zh: 给一本书、一首音乐等取一个特定的名字
example_zh: 他们的首张专辑名为《Made in Valmez》。

definition: a unit for measuring weight, in the UK 2 240 pounds (long ton) and in the US 2 000 pounds (short ton)
example: (informal), What have you got in this bag? It weighs a ton (= is very heavy).
definition_zh: 这是一种重量单位，英国为2 240磅（长吨），美国为2 000磅（短吨）
example_zh: （非正式）你这个包里装的是什么？它重达一吨（= 非常重）。

definition: the quality of somebody’s voice, especially expressing a particular emotion
example: speaking in hushed/low/clipped/measured, etc. tones
definition_zh: 一个人声音的质量，尤其是表达某种特定情绪时的声音
example_zh: 用低声、低声、简短、有节奏的语气说话

definition: a unit for measuring weight, equal to 1 000 kilograms
example: a record grain harvest of 236m tonnes
definition_zh: 一个用于测量重量的单位，等于1 000公斤
example_zh: 创纪录的2.36亿吨粮食收获

definition: having or causing problems or difficulties
example: a tough childhood
definition_zh: 遇到或造成问题或困难
example_zh: 一段艰难的童年

definition: a sports competition involving a number of teams or players who take part in different games and must leave the competition if they lose. The competition continues until there is only the winner left.
example: a golf/tennis/soccer/chess tournament
definition_zh: 一项体育比赛，涉及多个队伍或球员，他们参加不同的比赛，若输了必须退出比赛。比赛持续进行，直到只剩下冠军。
example_zh: 高尔夫/网球/足球/国际象棋锦标赛

definition: to find or discover somebody/something by looking carefully for them/it
example: We finally traced him to an address in Chicago.
definition_zh: 通过仔细寻找某人/某物/某物，来发现或发现他们/某物
example_zh: 我们终于追踪到他在芝加哥的一个地址。

definition: to find somebody/something by following the marks, signs, information, etc., that they have left behind them
example: track somebody/something, hunters tracking and shooting bears
definition_zh: 通过追踪他们留下的标记、迹象、信息等，找到某个人或某物
example_zh: 追踪某人/某物，猎人追踪并射杀熊

definition: the activity of buying and selling things
example: new laws on Sunday trading (= shops being open on Sundays)
definition_zh: 买卖物品的活动
example_zh: 关于周日营业的新法律（=商店周日营业）

definition: a very sad event or situation, especially one that involves death
example: It's a tragedy that she died so young.
definition_zh: 一个非常悲伤的事件或情境，尤其是涉及死亡的事件
example_zh: 她这么年轻就去世了，真是悲剧。

definition: making you feel very sad, usually because somebody has died or suffered a lot
example: He was killed in a tragic accident at the age of 24.
definition_zh: 让你感到非常难过，通常是因为有人去世或受了很多苦
example_zh: 他在24岁时因一场悲惨事故去世。

definition: a particular quality in your personality
example: personality traits
definition_zh: 你性格中的某种特殊品质
example_zh: 性格特质

definition: the act of moving somebody/something from one place, group or job to another; an occasion when this happens
example: electronic data transfer
definition_zh: 将某人或某物从一个地点、群体或工作转移到另一个地点的行为;发生这种情况的场合
example_zh: 电子数据传输

definition: to move from one place to another; to move something/somebody from one place to another
example: transfer (to something), The film studio is transferring to Hollywood.
definition_zh: 从一个地方移动到另一个地方;将某物或某人从一个地方移动到另一个地方
example_zh: 转会（到某处），电影制片厂正在搬迁到好莱坞。

definition: to change the form of something; to change in form
example: transform something/somebody (into something), The photochemical reactions transform the light into electrical impulses.
definition_zh: 改变某物的形态;改变形态
example_zh: 把某物/某人（变成某物），光化学反应将光转化为电脉冲。

definition: the process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another
example: transition from something to something, the transition from school to full-time work
definition_zh: 从一种状态或状态转变为另一种状态的过程或一段时间
example_zh: 从某样东西过渡到另一件事，从学校到全职工作的转变

definition: to send an electronic signal, radio or television broadcast, etc.
example: signals transmitted from a satellite
definition_zh: 用于发送电子信号、广播或电视广播等。
example_zh: 来自卫星传输的信号

definition: a system for carrying people or goods from one place to another using vehicles, roads, etc.
example: public transportation (= the system of buses, trains, etc. provided for people to travel from one place to another)
definition_zh: 一种利用车辆、道路等将人员或货物从一个地方运送到另一个地方的系统。
example_zh: 公共交通（= 为人们从一个地方到另一个地方提供的公交、火车等系统）

definition: a piece of equipment for catching animals
example: a fox with its leg in a trap
definition_zh: 一种用于捕捉动物的设备
example_zh: 一只被困在陷阱里的狐狸

definition: to put somebody in a dangerous place that they cannot get out of
example: be trapped, Help! I'm trapped!
definition_zh: 把某人置于一个无法脱身的危险境地
example_zh: 被困住了，救命！我被困住了！

definition: a collection of valuable things such as gold, silver and jewellery
example: buried treasure
definition_zh: 收藏了黄金、白银和首饰等贵重物品
example_zh: 埋藏的宝藏

definition: a formal examination of evidence in court by a judge and often a jury, to decide if somebody accused of a crime is guilty or not
example: a murder/criminal trial
definition_zh: 法官以及通常由陪审团在法庭上对证据进行正式审查，以判断被指控犯罪的人是否有罪
example_zh: 谋杀/刑事审判

definition: a social group in a traditional society consisting of people with the same language, culture, religion, etc., living in a particular area and often having one leader known as a chief
example: They were a nomadic horse-riding tribe.
definition_zh: 传统社会中的一个社会群体，由拥有相同语言、文化、宗教等信仰的人组成，居住在特定地区，通常有一位领导者被称为酋长
example_zh: 他们是一个游牧骑马部落。

definition: to make something happen suddenly
example: Nuts can trigger off a violent allergic reaction.
definition_zh: 让某件事突然发生
example_zh: 坚果可能会引发剧烈的过敏反应。

example: The country's debt reached one trillion dollars.
example_zh: 该国债务达到一万亿美元。

definition: to catch your foot on something and fall or almost fall
example: She tripped and fell.
definition_zh: 脚被什么东西绊住，跌倒或差点摔倒
example_zh: 她绊倒了，摔倒了。

definition: soldiers, especially in large groups
example: They announced the withdrawal of 12 000 troops from the area.
definition_zh: 士兵，尤其是大群体
example_zh: 他们宣布将有12,000名士兵从该地区撤出。

definition: coming from, found in or typical of the tropics
example: tropical fish/birds/fruit
definition_zh: 来自、分布于热带或典型的热带地区
example_zh: 热带鱼/鸟类/水果

definition: to make somebody worried or upset
example: What is it that's troubling you?
definition_zh: 让某人担心或难过
example_zh: 是什么困扰着你？

definition: used to emphasize that a particular statement, feeling, etc. is sincere or real
example: She truly believes that none of this is her fault.
definition_zh: 用于强调某一特定陈述、感受等是真诚或真实的
example_zh: 她真心相信这一切都不是她的错。

definition: the belief that somebody/something is good, sincere, honest, etc. and will not try to harm or trick you
example: Our partnership is based on trust.
definition_zh: 相信某人或某物是善良、真诚、诚实的，不会试图伤害或欺骗你
example_zh: 我们的合作建立在信任之上。

definition: to have confidence in somebody; to believe that somebody is good, sincere, honest, etc.
example: trust somebody, She trusts Alan implicitly.
definition_zh: 对某人有信心;相信某人是善良、真诚、诚实的，等等。
example_zh: 信任别人，她对艾伦信任得无比。

definition: an act of trying to do something
example: I doubt they'll be able to help but it's worth a try (= worth asking them).
definition_zh: 一种试图做点什么的行为
example_zh: 我怀疑他们能帮不上忙，但值得一试（= 值得问问他们）。

definition: an extremely large wave in the sea caused, for example, by an earthquake
example: A tsunami early warning system was set up in Hawaii.
definition_zh: 例如，由地震引发的海中极其巨大的海浪
example_zh: 夏威夷建立了海啸预警系统。

definition: a series of musical notes that are sung or played in a particular order to form a piece of music
example: to sing/whistle a tune
definition_zh: 一系列按特定顺序唱或演奏的音符，构成一首音乐作品
example_zh: 唱/吹口哨

definition: a passage built underground, for example to allow a road or railway to go through a hill, under a river, etc.
example: a railway/railroad tunnel
definition_zh: 例如，地下建造的通道，例如让道路或铁路穿过山丘、河流下方等。
example_zh: 一条铁路/铁路隧道

definition: happening at the end of a long process
example: our ultimate goal/aim/objective/target
definition_zh: 在漫长过程的终点发生
example_zh: 我们的最终目标/目标/目标/目标

definition: in the end; finally
example: A poor diet will ultimately lead to illness.
definition_zh: 最终;终于
example_zh: 不良饮食最终会导致疾病。

definition: so bad that you think it should not be allowed
example: Such behaviour is totally unacceptable in a civilized society.
definition_zh: 糟糕到你觉得不该允许
example_zh: 在一个文明社会中，这种行为是完全不可接受的。

definition: the state of being uncertain
example: There is considerable uncertainty about the company's future.
definition_zh: 不确定的状态
example_zh: 关于公司的未来存在相当大的不确定性。

definition: in a state like sleep because of an injury or illness, and not able to use your senses
example: They found him lying unconscious on the floor.
definition_zh: 处于类似睡眠状态，因为受伤或生病，无法使用感官
example_zh: 他们发现他昏迷倒在地上。

definition: to experience something, especially a change or something unpleasant
example: to undergo tests/trials/repairs
definition_zh: 体验某种东西，尤其是变化或不愉快的感受
example_zh: 接受测试/试验/维修

definition: to make yourself responsible for something and start doing it
example: to undertake a task/project
definition_zh: 让自己对某件事负责并开始去做
example_zh: 执行任务/项目

definition: if something is unexpected, it surprises you because you were not expecting it
example: Things took an unexpected turn.
definition_zh: 如果某件事出乎意料，那会让你感到惊讶，因为你原本没预料到。
example_zh: 事情出现了意想不到的转折。

definition: to spread open or flat something that has previously been folded; to become open and flat
example: to unfold a map
definition_zh: 将先前折叠过的物体展开或摊平;使之展开且平整
example_zh: 展开地图

definition: having bad luck; caused by bad luck
example: He was unfortunate to lose in the final round.
definition_zh: 运气不好;由坏运气引起的
example_zh: 他在决赛轮中不幸落败。

definition: being the only one of its kind
example: Everyone's fingerprints are unique.
definition_zh: 它是独一无二的
example_zh: 每个人的指纹都是独一无二的。

definition: to join together with other people in order to do something as a group
example: Nationalist parties united to oppose the government's plans.
definition_zh: 与其他人联合起来，作为一个团队去做某件事
example_zh: 民族主义政党联合起来反对政府的计划。

definition: the state of being in agreement and working together; the state of being joined together to form one unit
example: European unity
definition_zh: 达成一致并共同工作的状态;合而为一的状态，形成一个整体
example_zh: 欧洲团结

definition: done by or involving all the people in the world or in a particular group
example: Such problems are a universal feature of old age.
definition_zh: 由全世界所有人或某个特定群体共同完成或参与其中
example_zh: 这些问题是老年普遍现象。

definition: the whole of space and everything in it, including the earth, the planets and the stars
example: in the universe, Could there be intelligent life elsewhere in the universe?
definition_zh: 整个空间以及其中的一切，包括地球、行星和恒星
example_zh: 宇宙中，宇宙中可能存在智慧生命吗？

definition: not known or identified
example: A previously unknown group claimed responsibility for the bombing.
definition_zh: 未知或未确认身份
example_zh: 一个此前未知的团体声称对爆炸负责。

definition: located above something else, especially something of the same type or the other of a pair
example: her upper lip
definition_zh: 位于其他物体之上，尤其是同类型或一对之中的另一处
example_zh: 她的上唇

definition: towards a higher place or position
example: Place your hands on the table with the palms facing upwards.
definition_zh: 朝着更高的地方或位置
example_zh: 把双手放在桌上，掌心朝上。

definition: connected with a town or city
example: urban and rural communities
definition_zh: 与城镇或城市相关联
example_zh: 城市与农村社区

definition: to advise or try hard to persuade somebody to do something
example: urge somebody to do something, If you ever get the chance to visit this place, I strongly urge you to do so.
definition_zh: 建议或努力说服某人去做某件事
example_zh: 催促某人做点什么，如果你有机会来这里，我强烈建议你一定要去。

definition: that needs to be dealt with or happen immediately
example: The police have issued an urgent appeal for information.
definition_zh: 这需要立即处理或立即处理
example_zh: 警方已发出紧急呼吁，要求提供信息。

definition: the way in which words are used in a language
example: a book on current English usage
definition_zh: 语言中词语的使用方式
example_zh: 一本关于当前英语用法的书

definition: not useful; not doing or achieving what is needed or wanted
example: This pen is useless.
definition_zh: 没有用处;没有做或完成所需或想要的事
example_zh: 这支笔没用。

definition: that is legally or officially acceptable
example: Do you have a valid passport?
definition_zh: 这是法律或官方上可以接受的
example_zh: 你有有效护照吗？

definition: to think that somebody/something is important
example: value somebody/something, He has come to value her advice and support.
definition_zh: 认为某人/某物很重要
example_zh: 珍视某人/某物，他已经开始珍视她的建议和支持。

definition: a change, especially in the amount or level of something
example: The dial records very slight variations in pressure.
definition_zh: 变化，尤其是在某件事的数量或程度上
example_zh: 表盘记录的压力变化非常细微。

definition: to be different from each other in size, shape, etc.
example: New techniques were introduced with varying degrees of success.
definition_zh: 它们在大小、形状等方面都有所不同。
example_zh: 新技术被引入，成效不一。

definition: extremely large in area, size, amount, etc.
example: a vast area of forest
definition_zh: 在面积、大小、数量等方面都极其庞大。
example_zh: 一片广袤的森林

definition: a place where people meet for an organized event, for example a concert, sporting event or conference
example: The band will be playing at 20 different venues on their UK tour.
definition_zh: 人们为组织活动（例如音乐会、体育赛事或会议）聚在一起的地方
example_zh: 乐队将在英国巡演期间于20个不同的场地演出。

definition: going straight up or down from a level surface or from top to bottom in a picture, etc.
example: the vertical axis of the graph
definition_zh: 比如从平面直上或直下，或者在图片中从上到下，等等。
example_zh: 图的垂直轴

definition: used to emphasize that you are talking about a particular thing or person and not about another
example: He might be phoning her at this very moment.
definition_zh: 用来强调你谈论的是某个特定的事情或人物，而不是另一个
example_zh: 他可能此刻正给她打电话。

definition: through a place
example: We flew home via Dubai.
definition_zh: 穿过一个地方
example_zh: 我们经迪拜飞回家。

definition: success in a game, an election, a war, etc.
example: to win a narrow victory
definition_zh: 在游戏、选举、战争等中取得成功。
example_zh: 以微弱优势赢得胜利

definition: a way of thinking about a subject
example: from a… viewpoint, Try looking at things from a different viewpoint.
definition_zh: 一种思考主题的方式
example_zh: 从一个......视角，试着换个角度看问题。

definition: violent behaviour that is intended to hurt or kill somebody
example: Police do not think this killing was a random act of violence.
definition_zh: 旨在伤害或杀害他人的暴力行为
example_zh: 警方认为这起杀人案并非随机暴力行为。

definition: made to appear to exist by the use of computer software, for example on the internet
example: a system to help programmers create virtual environments
definition_zh: 通过使用计算机软件，例如在互联网上，假装存在
example_zh: 一个帮助程序员创建虚拟环境的系统

definition: a stamp or mark put in your passport by officials of a foreign country that gives you permission to enter, pass through or leave their country
example: to apply for a visa
definition_zh: 由外国官员在护照上盖印或标记，允许你进入、通过或离开该国
example_zh: 申请签证

definition: that can be seen
example: The house is clearly visible from the beach.
definition_zh: 这一点可以看出来
example_zh: 从海滩上可以清楚地看到这座房子。

definition: the ability to see; the area that you can see from a particular position
example: to have good/perfect/poor/blurred/normal vision
definition_zh: 能够看到;你从某个特定位置能看到的区域
example_zh: 拥有良好/完美/差/模糊/正常视力

definition: of or connected with seeing or sight
example: the visual arts
definition_zh: 与视觉或视觉有关或与之相关
example_zh: 视觉艺术

definition: necessary or essential in order for something to succeed or exist
example: vital for somebody/something, the vitamins that are vital for health
definition_zh: 为使某事成功或存在所必需或必要
example_zh: 对某人/某物至关重要，那些对健康至关重要的维生素

definition: a natural substance found in food that is an essential part of what humans and animals need to help them grow and stay healthy. There are many different vitamins.
example: vitamin A/B/D/E
definition_zh: 这是一种存在于食物中的天然物质，是人类和动物帮助它们成长和保持健康所必需的重要组成部分。维生素有很多种。
example_zh: 维生素A/B/D/E

definition: the amount of space that an object or a substance fills; the amount of space that a container has
example: volume of something, How do you measure the volume of a gas?
definition_zh: 物体或物质所占满的空间;容器所拥有的空间
example_zh: 某物的体积，你如何测量气体的体积？

definition: done willingly, not because you are forced
example: a voluntary agreement
definition_zh: 这是自愿的，而不是被迫
example_zh: 自愿协议

definition: the action of choosing somebody/something in an election or at a meeting
example: He was eliminated in the first round of voting.
definition_zh: 在选举或会议上选择某人/某物的行为
example_zh: 他在第一轮投票中被淘汰。

definition: a regular amount of money that you earn, usually every week or every month, for work or services
example: wage/wages of something, wages of £300 a week
definition_zh: 你每周或每月为工作或服务而获得的固定收入
example_zh: 工资/某项工资，每周300英镑工资

definition: to walk slowly around or to a place, often without any particular sense of purpose or direction
example: + adv./prep., She wandered aimlessly around the streets.
definition_zh: 慢慢地绕着走，或者走向某个地方，往往没有特别的目的或方向感
example_zh: + 副词/介词，她漫无目的地在街上游荡。

definition: the process of making something, or of becoming, warm or warmer
example: atmospheric warming
definition_zh: 让某物变得温暖或变得温暖的过程
example_zh: 大气变暖

definition: very far; by a large amount
example: She finished the race way ahead of the other runners.
definition_zh: 非常远;差距很大
example_zh: 她远远领先其他跑者完成比赛。

definition: lack of physical strength
example: The disease causes progressive muscle weakness.
definition_zh: 体力不足
example_zh: 该疾病会导致渐进性肌肉无力。

definition: a large amount of money, property, etc. that a person or country owns
example: the desire to gain wealth and power
definition_zh: 一个人或国家拥有的大量金钱、财产等
example_zh: 渴望获得财富和权力

definition: having a lot of money, possessions, etc.
example: a wealthy businessman/individual/family
definition_zh: 拥有大量金钱、财产等等。
example_zh: 一位富有的商人/个人/家庭

definition: happening, done or published once a week or every week
example: weekly meetings
definition_zh: 每周或每周完成或发布一次
example_zh: 每周会议

definition: very strange or unusual and difficult to explain
example: I had a really weird dream last night.
definition_zh: 非常奇怪或异常，难以解释
example_zh: 我昨晚做了一个非常奇怪的梦。

definition: the general health, happiness and safety of a person, an animal or a group
example: We are concerned about the child's welfare.
definition_zh: 个人、动物或群体的整体健康、幸福和安全
example_zh: 我们关心孩子的福祉。

definition: a plant grown for its grain that is used to produce the flour for bread, cakes, pasta, etc.; the grain of this plant
example: wheat flour
definition_zh: 一种为其谷物而种植的植物，用于生产面包、蛋糕、意大利面等的面粉;该植物的谷物
example_zh: 小麦面粉

definition: used to compare or contrast two facts
example: Some of the studies show positive results, whereas others do not.
definition_zh: 用于比较或对比两个事实
example_zh: 有些研究显示了积极的结果，而另一些则没有。

definition: in any place
example: Sit wherever you like.
definition_zh: 在任何地方
example_zh: 随便坐哪儿。

definition: a low, quiet voice or the sound it makes
example: in a whisper, ‘I love you,’ he said in a whisper.
definition_zh: 低沉、安静的声音，或者它发出的声音
example_zh: 他低声说：“我爱你，”他低声说。

definition: to speak very quietly to somebody so that other people cannot hear what you are saying
example: Don't you know it's rude to whisper?
definition_zh: 对别人说话要非常轻声，这样别人听不到你在说什么
example_zh: 你不知道低声说话很没礼貌吗？

definition: the person or people who; any person who
example: Whoever says that is a liar.
definition_zh: 该人或多个人;任何
example_zh: 谁说这话就是骗子。

definition: used instead of ‘who’ as the object of a verb or preposition
example: Whom did they invite?
definition_zh: 作为动词或介词的宾语，代替“who”使用
example_zh: 他们邀请了谁？

definition: by a lot of people; in or to many places
example: The term is widely used in everyday speech.
definition_zh: 由许多人;在许多地方或在许多地方
example_zh: 这个词在日常言语中被广泛使用。

definition: existing or happening over a large area or among many people
example: The storm caused widespread damage.
definition_zh: 存在或正在大范围或多人之间发生
example_zh: 这场风暴造成了广泛的破坏。

definition: animals, birds, insects, etc. that are wild and live in a natural environment
example: policies designed to protect wildlife
definition_zh: 野生动物、鸟类、昆虫等，生活在自然环境中
example_zh: 旨在保护野生动物的政策

definition: not objecting to doing something; having no reason for not doing something
example: Many consumers are willing to pay more for organic food
definition_zh: 不反对做某事;没有理由不做某事
example_zh: 许多消费者愿意为有机食品支付更高价格

definition: to have many bends and twists
example: wind + adv./prep., The path wound down to the beach.
definition_zh: 要有许多弯曲和扭曲
example_zh: 风 + 进度/准备，小径蜿蜒而下，通往海滩。

definition: metal in the form of thin thread; a piece of this
example: a coil of copper wire
definition_zh: 以细线形式呈现的金属;这块
example_zh: 一卷铜线

definition: the ability to make sensible decisions and give good advice because of the experience and knowledge that you have
example: She was known to be a woman of great wisdom.
definition_zh: 凭借自身的经验和知识，能够做出明智决策并提供良好建议
example_zh: 她以极具智慧著称。

definition: able to make sensible decisions and give good advice because of the experience and knowledge that you have
example: a wise man
definition_zh: 凭借你的经验和知识，你能够做出明智的决定并提供良好建议
example_zh: 一位智者

definition: to take money out of a bank account
example: withdraw something, With this account, you can withdraw up to £300 a day.
definition_zh: 从银行账户取钱
example_zh: 取点什么，用这个账户，你每天最多可以取300英镑。

definition: a person who sees something happen and is able to describe it to other people
example: He failed to interview a key witness.
definition_zh: 一个看到某件事发生并能向别人描述的人
example_zh: 他没有采访一位关键证人。

definition: to see something happen (typically a crime or an accident)
example: to witness an accident/a murder/an attack
definition_zh: 亲眼目睹某事发生（通常是犯罪或意外）
example_zh: 目睹一场意外/谋杀/一场袭击

definition: all the people who work for a particular company, organization, etc.
example: The factory has a 1 000-strong workforce.
definition_zh: 所有在某一家公司、某个组织等工作的人。
example_zh: 工厂拥有1000名员工。

definition: the office, factory, etc. where people work
example: the introduction of new technology into the workplace
definition_zh: 人们工作的办公室、工厂等
example_zh: 新技术进入工作场所

definition: a period of discussion and practical work on a particular subject, in which a group of people share their knowledge and experience
example: There will be the opportunity for practical theatre work in drama workshops.
definition_zh: 一个围绕特定主题进行讨论和实践工作的时期，一群人在此分享他们的知识和经验
example_zh: 在戏剧工作坊中，将有机会进行实践戏剧工作。

definition: a long, thin creature with a soft body and no bones or legs
example: birds looking for worms
definition_zh: 一种细长、身体柔软、没有骨头和腿的生物
example_zh: 寻找蚯蚓的鸟类

definition: more problems or bad news
example: I'm afraid there is worse to come.
definition_zh: 更多问题或坏消息
example_zh: 恐怕还会有更糟的事发生。

definition: the most serious or unpleasant thing that could happen; the part, situation, possibility, etc. that is worse than any other
example: When they did not hear from her, they feared the worst.
definition_zh: 最严重或最令人不快的事情;比任何其他情况都更糟糕的部分、情况、可能性等等
example_zh: 当他们没有收到她的消息时，他们担心最坏的情况。

definition: an amount of something that has the value mentioned
example: The winner will receive fifty pounds' worth of books.
definition_zh: 具有上述价值的物品数量
example_zh: 获胜者将获得价值五十英镑的书籍。

definition: an injury to part of the body, especially one in which a hole is made in the skin using a weapon
example: a gunshot/stab wound
definition_zh: 身体部位受伤，尤其是用武器在皮肤上打出洞的伤
example_zh: 枪伤/刀伤

definition: to injure part of the body, especially by making a hole in the skin using a weapon
example: He had been wounded in the arm.
definition_zh: 伤害身体部位，尤其是用武器在皮肤上打个洞
example_zh: 他的手臂受伤了。

definition: to cover something completely in paper or other material, for example when you are giving it as a present
example: wrap something up, He spent the evening wrapping up the Christmas presents.
definition_zh: 比如当你把某样东西当作礼物送出时，完全用纸或其他材料覆盖
example_zh: 把点东西包好，他整个晚上都在收拾圣诞礼物。

definition: the joint between the hand and the arm
example: She's broken her wrist.
definition_zh: 手与手臂之间的关节
example_zh: 她手腕骨折了。

definition: behaviour that is not honest or morally acceptable
example: Children must be taught the difference between right and wrong.
definition_zh: 不诚实或不道德的行为
example_zh: 孩子们必须被教导分辨对错。

definition: despite what has just been said
example: It's a small car, yet it's surprisingly spacious.
definition_zh: 尽管刚才说了这些
example_zh: 这是一辆小车，但出乎意料地宽敞。

definition: an area or a region with a particular feature or use
example: a war/combat/demilitarized/exclusion zone
